title: Exact branch-transfer criterion for common-mode Thomson heat cancellation in thermoelectric couples
summary: Thermoelectric p- and n-type legs are commonly paired by matching their Seebeck magnitudes, although a cooler responds to heat transported through its complete electrical and thermal network. We decompose the leg coefficients into differential thermopower $α=S_p-S_n$ and common thermopower $M=(S_p+S_n)/2$. In a connected steady-state scalar thermoelectric network, a temperature-independent co-shift applied to every electrically active segment is an exact terminal null. A temperature-dependent perturbation of the legs relative to fixed leads is instead physical. At fixed current and shared isothermal endpoints, its first-order cold-port response is the action of $Γ_m=T\,dm/dT$ on the difference between the p- and n-branch oriented collection measures. We prove that every continuous $Γ_m$ cancels if and only if these measures are equal. In the constant-property, linear-common-mode limit, matching $R_i/K_i^{\rm leg}$ is sufficient and does not require identical legs. One- and two-dimensional calculations confirm the analytic reductions within their stated domains. For split thermal pads, the analysis gives the exact array law $ΔQ_{c,Σ}=\sum_j C_jI_jΔT_{c,j}$ and, for series elements with isothermal hot pairs, $IΔV_Σ=-ΔQ_{c,Σ}$. A representative seven-pair model gives corresponding increments of 7.87 mW and $-2.80$ mV. Branch transfer and endpoint topology therefore provide distinct material-pairing and device-test criteria for common-mode Thomson heat.

AI.tldr: 本文研究热电制冷器中p/n型臂的共模汤姆逊热效应，通过将臂系数分解为差分热电势α和共模热电势M，证明在连接的稳态标量热电网络中，与温度无关的共模平移是终端无效量，而温度相关的微扰是物理的，并建立了材料配对与器件测试的准则。
AI.motivation: 传统上仅通过匹配p型和n型臂的Seebeck系数大小来配对热电腿，但制冷器实际上响应的是通过其完整电热网络传输的热量。作者希望揭示共模热电势（M）和差分热电势（α）的区分对热电腿配对和器件测试的重要性，特别是共模汤姆逊热的影响。
AI.method: 将腿系数分解为差分热电势α=S_p-S_n和共模热电势M=(S_p+S_n)/2；建立连接的稳态标量热电网络模型；证明温度无关共模平移是精确终端零效应；对温度相关扰动进行一阶冷端响应分析，引入算子Γ_m=T dm/dT作用于p与n分支定向集合测度之差；在恒定属性和线性共模极限下推导充分条件；通过一维和二维计算及七对模型验证。
AI.result: 证明了每个连续Γ_m的抵消当且仅当p和n分支的定向集合测度相等；在恒定属性线性共模极限下，匹配R_i/K_i^leg是充分的且不需要相同腿；推导出分裂热垫的精确阵列定律ΔQ_c,Σ=Σ_j C_j I_j ΔT_c,j以及串联元件的IΔV_Σ=-ΔQ_c,Σ；七对模型的增量分别为7.87 mW和-2.80 mV。
AI.conclusion: 分支传递和端点拓扑为共模汤姆逊热提供了不同的材料配对和器件测试准则。仅匹配Seebeck参数大小是不够的，还需要考虑共模热电势对热网络完整传输的影响。

title: Ab initio Modeling of MoS2/Oxide Device Interfaces with Machine Learned Electronic Structures
summary: We introduce a new ab initio approach to simulate semiconductor devices that integrates scalable machine-learned (ML) electronic structure models with an advanced quantum transport (QT) solver. The developed framework enables 10,000X speedups over density functional theory to produce the Hamiltonian matrix of devices made of >20,000 atoms, while offering high prediction accuracy. We use its unique features to investigate MoS2/oxide samples and single-layer MoS2 field-effect transistors, where the surrounding oxide layers, here, HfO2 or Al2O3, are explicitly included into the QT domain. In particular, we reveal that the presence of undercoordinated metal atoms (Hf or Al) close to the semiconductor-oxide interface significantly affects the magnitude of the electronic current and its propagation through MoS2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合机器学习电子结构模型与先进量子输运求解器的全新从头算方法，用于模拟半导体器件，实现对超过20,000原子器件的哈密顿矩阵构建，相比密度泛函理论提速10,000倍，并揭示了金属氧化物（HfO2/Al2O3）中配位不足的金属原子对MoS2电子输运的显著影响。
AI.motivation: 传统基于密度泛函理论的量子输运模拟受限于计算成本，难以处理包含大量原子（如>20,000个）的实际器件，尤其是当周围氧化物层需要显式纳入量子输运区域时，计算负担更加沉重，亟需一种既高效又准确的替代方案。
AI.method: 将可扩展的机器学习电子结构模型与先进的量子输运求解器集成到一个从头算框架中，以机器学习模型替代DFT高效生成哈密顿矩阵，再交由量子输运求解器进行电子传输计算，从而兼顾速度与精度。
AI.result: 该框架相比DFT实现了10,000倍的加速，可处理超过20,000个原子的器件，并保持高预测精度。通过研究MoS2/氧化物样品及单层MoS2场效应晶体管，发现靠近半导体-氧化物界面的配位不足金属原子（Hf或Al）会显著影响电子电流的大小及其在MoS2中的传播。
AI.conclusion: 该ab initio框架为大规模半导体器件的量子输运模拟提供了高效且准确的途径，并成功揭示了界面配位不足金属原子对MoS2器件电学性能的关键影响，为理解及优化器件界面提供了新的物理洞察。

title: Collinear altermagnetism for 3D chiral higher-order topological insulators
summary: Despite significant progress in the study of higher-order topological insulators (HOTIs), the chiral $C_4\mathcal{T}$-protected HOTI has remained elusive in electronic materials, where $C_4\mathcal{T}$ denotes the product of a four-fold rotation and time-reversal symmetry. We show that altermagnetism, a recently discovered form of collinear magnetism, provides a new route to realize this elusive phase. Specifically, we construct a microscopic model that combines a three-dimensional topological insulator with a collinear $d$-wave altermagnet on a Lieb lattice. Through analytical and numerical calculations, we show that the magnetism shifts and gaps the surface Dirac cones to produce the desired chiral hinge channels. Finally, we identify promising material classes to realise our proposal. Our results establish collinear altermagnetism as a route to intrinsic chiral higher-order topology and open a new path toward the discovery of $C_4\mathcal{T}$-protected HOTIs in real materials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用交变磁性（altermagnetism）——一种新发现的共线磁性形式——作为实现C₄𝒯保护的宇称-时间高阶拓扑绝缘体（HOTI）的新途径。作者构建了一个微观模型，将三维拓扑绝缘体与Lieb晶格上的d波交变磁体结合，通过解析和数值计算证明磁性可以移动并打开表面狄拉克锥，产生所需的手性铰链通道，并识别了有前景的材料类别。
AI.motivation: 尽管高阶拓扑绝缘体（HOTIs）研究已有显著进展，但受C₄𝒯（四重旋转与时间反演对称性的乘积）保护的手性HOTI在电子材料中一直难以实现。作者旨在寻找一种新的物理机制来实现这一难以捉摸的相。
AI.method: 作者构建了一个微观模型，将三维拓扑绝缘体与Lieb晶格上的共线d波交变磁体相结合。通过解析和数值计算，证明磁性能够移动并打开表面狄拉克锥，从而产生手性铰链通道。此外，他们还识别了有望实现该方案的候选材料类别。
AI.result: 交变磁性可以有效移动并打开表面狄拉克锥，成功产生所需的C₄𝒯保护的手性铰链通道，从而实现此前难以捉摸的手性高阶拓扑相。研究还识别了可实现该方案的具体材料类别。
AI.conclusion: 该工作确立了共线交变磁性作为实现本征手性高阶拓扑的可行途径，为在真实材料中寻找C₄𝒯保护的HOTI开辟了新的道路。

title: Compiling Chemical Knowledge into Executable Descriptors for Materials Prediction
summary: Materials prediction depends critically on how scientific knowledge is represented, yet many governing considerations exist only as natural-language heuristics that conventional learners cannot use. We introduce CRISP, a large language model-assisted framework that treats representation construction as a rule-space exploration and compilation problem: it repeatedly samples target-relevant chemical rules without access to structures, labels or data splits, consolidates related concepts, and compiles each into an executable scalar descriptor supplied to a conventional learner. For positive-unlabeled inorganic-crystal synthesizability, CRISP outperformed expert-curated and generic structural representations under a shared learner and surpassed purpose-built synthesizability models, with its advantage most pronounced under structural-size and chemical-family shifts. Infrequently generated rules contributed complementary predictive information, showing that generation frequency does not determine utility. The same workflow yielded competitive representations for formation energy and ionic conductivity while revealing task-dependent limits for shear modulus, establishing a dataset-blind, auditable route from broad chemical knowledge to transferable computational representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CRISP框架，利用大语言模型将自然语言形式的化学规则转化为可执行的标量描述符，供传统机器学习模型使用。在无机晶体可合成性预测等任务中，CRISP生成的表示优于专家人工设计和通用结构表示，且无需访问数据结构标签或数据划分。
AI.motivation: 材料预测高度依赖科学知识的表示方式，但许多关键知识仅以自然语言启发式规则形式存在，传统机器学习方法无法直接利用这些规则进行预测。
AI.method: CRISP将表示构建视为规则空间探索与编译问题：反复采样与目标相关的化学规则（无需结构、标签或数据划分），整合相关概念，并将每条规则编译为可执行的标量描述符，供传统学习器使用。
AI.result: 在正-未标记无机晶体可合成性任务中，CRISP在共享学习器下优于专家人工和通用结构表示，并超过专用可合成性模型；其优势在结构尺寸和化学族偏移下最为显著。低频生成的规则仍提供互补预测信息。同一流程在形成能和离子电导率上表现良好，但在剪切模量上揭示了任务依赖的局限性。
AI.conclusion: CRISP建立了数据集盲、可审计的路径，从广泛的化学知识到可迁移的计算表示，证明生成频率不代表规则效用，为材料预测提供了一种不依赖专家人工设计的表示构建新范式。

title: Adaptive workforce exploration in complex productivity landscapes
summary: Specialization and task allocation enhance efficiency and innovation across diverse systems, from biological organisms to socioeconomic institutions. The evolution of task distribution and its influence on organizational productivity encapsulate the dynamics between task dependencies and adaptive strategies. We explore the organizational division of labor, inspired by the NK model of rugged landscapes, which is widely applied in evolutionary biology, and incorporate interdependencies among the attributes of technical experts within an organization. Our model considers two types of employees characterized by their task allocation strategies: specialists, who are permanently assigned to a single task, and generalists, who stochastically select a task at each time step. We investigate how the ruggedness of the productivity landscape, shaped by task interdependency, affects the organization's capacity to optimize labor division and meet market demands. Using group selection algorithms, we reveal the emergence of nonlinear adaptive dynamics, providing insights into how companies can adapt their strategies to meet market demands and foster innovation.

AI.tldr: 本文受NK模型启发，研究组织中专家与通才两类员工的任务分配策略。专家固定分配单一任务，通才随机选择任务，通过群体选择算法探索任务依赖度（地形崎岖度）如何影响组织劳动分工优化能力和市场适应能力，揭示非线性自适应动态及其对企业创新和战略适应的启示。
AI.motivation: 任务分工和专业化是提升组织效率与创新的关键机制，但任务之间的依赖关系如何影响组织选择最优劳动分工策略尚不清楚。作者希望借鉴进化生物学中NK崎岖地貌模型，将任务间相互依赖纳入组织分工的演化分析中，以理解专家与通才策略在不同复杂性环境下的优劣。
AI.method: 构建一个基于NK模型的组织分工模型，定义两类员工：专家（永久分配单一任务）和通才（每个时间步随机选择任务）。通过群体选择算法（group selection）模拟组织在不同任务依赖程度（地貌崎岖度）下的演化过程，考察组织优化劳动分工和满足市场需求的能力。
AI.result: 研究揭示了非线性自适应动态的涌现，说明任务依赖度（地形崎岖度）显著影响组织的劳动分工优化能力。不同崎岖度下的专家与通才策略表现存在差异，为企业在复杂环境中调整策略提供了理论依据。
AI.conclusion: 任务依赖性是决定组织分工策略有效性的关键因素。企业需根据任务环境的复杂度动态调整专家化与通才化策略比例，以保持市场适应性和创新能力。该模型为理解组织演化与创新管理提供了新的定量分析框架。

title: Two-dimensional quantum Griffith singularity in three-dimensional ZrN$_x$ superconducting films
summary: We report the experimental observation of two-dimensional (2D) quantum Griffiths singularity (QGS) in $\sim$200-nm-thick epitaxial ZrN$_x$ superconducting films. The films possess a rock-salt structure and are three-dimensional (3D) with respect to superconductivity. For each film with $x \gtrsim 1.30$, the low-temperature magnetoresistance isotherms under fields perpendicular and parallel to the film plane cross over at a broad magnetic field range independently rather than at a single crossing point. Despite the macroscopic 3D nature of the superconductivity, the magnetoresistance isotherms at selected adjacent temperatures follow the theoretical prediction of power-law scaling for 2D superconducting systems, rather than that for 3D systems. The effective critical exponent $zν$, obtained by analyzing the magnetoresistance isotherms using the 2D power-law scaling, increases with decreasing temperature and diverges as the quantum phase transition is approached. In addition, the resistivity data near the superconductor-insulator or superconductor-metal transitions obey an activated scaling form that describes the quantum phase transition of 2D superconducting systems governed by an infinite-randomness critical point. The QGS in the ZrN$_x$ films is attributed to quenched disorder induced by intrinsic defects, such as Zr vacancies and N interstitials, which creates spatially inhomogeneous superconducting rare regions. The dynamics of these rare regions, which may exhibit effective 2D characteristics near the quantum critical point, dominate the transport properties of the system near the quantum phase transition. Our results provide compelling evidence for the existence of QGS in 3D superconductors and highlight the crucial role of disorder-induced inhomogeneity in determining the critical behavior of quantum phase transitions.

AI.tldr: 本文报道了在约200纳米厚的外延ZrNx超导薄膜中实验观测到二维量子格里菲斯奇异性(QGS)。尽管薄膜在超导性方面是宏观三维的，但其磁阻等温线却遵循二维超导系统的幂律标度行为，有效临界指数zν随温度降低而发散，呈现出无限随机临界点的特征。QGS归因于Zr空位和N间隙等内在缺陷引起的淬灭无序，这些缺陷创造了空间不均匀的超导稀有区域。
AI.motivation: 量子格里菲斯奇异性(QGS)是量子相变研究中的重要现象，此前主要在二维超导系统中被观测到。本文的动机是探讨QGS是否也能存在于三维超导体中，以及无序诱导的不均匀性如何影响量子相变的临界行为，从而扩展对QGS普适性的理解。
AI.method: 研究者制备了约200纳米厚的具有岩盐结构的外延ZrNx超导薄膜(x≳1.30)，通过测量平行和垂直于薄膜平面的低温柔磁场磁阻等温线，分析其跨越行为。他们利用二维超导系统的幂律标度理论拟合磁阻数据，提取有效临界指数zν并研究其温度依赖性，同时分析了超导体-绝缘体/超导体-金属转变附近的激活标度行为。
AI.result: 研究发现：磁阻等温线在宽磁场范围内交叉而非单一交叉点；磁阻数据遵循二维而非三维超导系统的幂律标度；有效临界指数zν随温度降低而增大并在量子相变附近发散；电阻率数据符合无限随机临界点控制的二维超导系统量子相变的激活标度形式。这些证据表明QGS存在于三维超导体中。
AI.conclusion: ZrNx薄膜中的QGS源于内在缺陷（Zr空位和N间隙）导致的淬灭无序，这些缺陷产生了空间不均匀的超导稀有区域。这些稀有区域在量子临界点附近展现出有效的二维特征并主导输运性质。研究结果为三维超导体中存在QGS提供了有力证据，强调了无序诱导的不均匀性在决定量子相变临界行为中的关键作用。

title: Orbital-Selective Coexistence of Interlayer Spin-Singlet Formation and SDW Order with Anomalous Spin Reconfiguration in Bilayer Nickelate La$_{3}$Ni$_{2}$O$_{7}$ Revealed by $^{17}$O-NMR
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Accepted for publication in J. Phys. Soc. Jpn
summary: The spin structure of the spin density wave (SDW) order in the bilayer nickelate La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$ has been investigated using site-selective $^{17}$O-NMR measurements on the inner apical O(1), outer apical O(2), and planar O(3,4) sites. Below $T_{\rm SDW}$ (= 150 K), the peak of all planar O(3,4) sites significantly broadens due to the emergence of a finite internal magnetic field, whereas O(2) sites remain with no (or a negligibly small) internal field. These results are consistent with commensurate SDW order with a single spin-spinless (or large-tiny spin) stripe. As for the O(1) sites that bridge the NiO$_2$ planes, the internal field is nearly canceled below $T_{\rm SDW}$, indicating an antiparallel spin configuration between adjacent planes. However, below $T_\text{A}$ ($\sim$ 115 K), the spectrum of the O(1) site disappears even though the in-plane SDW order remains robust, implying that the antiparallel spin configuration through the Ni--O(1)--Ni bond is not particularly stable below $T_{\rm A}$, despite the expected strong interlayer spin coupling between the NiO$_2$ planes. Above all, we emphasize that the local spin susceptibility is extremely small at the O(2) site that has a strong covalency with the $d_{3z^2-r^2}$ orbital, indicating a well-developed interlayer spin-singlet formation in the Ni-$d_{3z^2-r^2}$ orbitals bridging the NiO$_2$ planes. These findings shed new light on the interlayer spin-singlet formation and the anomalous spin reconfiguration through the $\text{Ni--O(1)--Ni}$ bonding orbitals connecting the NiO$_2$ planes, which characterize the orbital-selective nature of the bilayer nickelate La$_3$Ni$_2$O$_7$.

AI.tldr: 本文通过位点选择性¹⁷O-NMR测量，研究了双层镍酸盐La₃Ni₂O₇中自旋密度波（SDW）序的自旋结构。研究发现：平面O(3,4)位点的内部磁场显著增宽，O(2)位点几乎无内部磁场，O(1)位点在T_SDW以下内部磁场近似抵消（表明层间反平行自旋排列），但T_A(~115K)以下O(1)谱线消失。最重要的是，O(2)位点的局域自旋磁化率极低，表明Ni-d₃z²₋r²轨道形成了良好的层间自旋单重态。
AI.motivation: 理解双层镍酸盐La₃Ni₂O₇中SDW序的自旋结构及其与超导电性的关系，特别是层间自旋耦合和轨道选择性行为如何影响磁有序与超导的共存。
AI.method: 采用位点选择性的¹⁷O-NMR测量，分别对内部顶位O(1)、外部顶位O(2)和平面O(3,4)位点进行探测，通过分析各氧位点的NMR谱线增宽和内部磁场变化，推断SDW的自旋排列结构。
AI.result: (1) T_SDW=150K以下，平面O(3,4)位点谱线显著增宽，表明存在有限内部磁场，与单一自旋-无自旋（或大-小自旋）条状SDW序一致；(2) O(1)位点在T_SDW以下内部场近似抵消，表明相邻NiO₂平面间为反平行自旋排列；(3) T_A≈115K以下O(1)位点谱线消失，表明层间反平行自旋配置变得不稳定；(4) O(2)位点局域自旋磁化率极低，表明Ni-d₃z²₋r²轨道形成充分发展的层间自旋单重态。
AI.conclusion: 该研究揭示了La₃Ni₂O₇中SDW序具有轨道选择性特征：d₃z²₋r²轨道形成层间自旋单重态，而面内SDW序通过Ni-O(1)-Ni键实现层间反平行排列。T_A以下发生的异常自旋重构表明层间自旋耦合并不稳定，这对理解双层镍酸盐的超导机制提供了新的见解。

title: OrbGNN: A Wave function-based Machine Learning Interelectronic Representation
summary: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) have become emerging tools in molecular modeling and computational chemistry. By learning high-dimensional potential energy surfaces from quantum chemical data, MLIPs enable accurate and efficient predictions of structural, thermodynamic, and dynamical properties. However, such models have limitations in predictions of electronic properties and the effects of static electron correlation due to their lack of electronic structure information. This work presents OrbGNN, an electronic structure graph architecture analogous to molecular graph and MLIP frameworks, where pair-orbital interactions constitute the graph representation, while orbital entanglement encodes the connectivity between them. By embedding information derived from orbital correlation metrics directly into the graph topology, OrbGNN provides a compact representation of a molecule s orbital landscape and electron correlation patterns. Analysis of the behavior of the feature space in an orbital graph are shown to demonstrate model robustness. The model is evaluated for the dissociation of nitrogen and for a larger dataset of diatomic molecules. Finally, the OrbGNN model is applied to a set of octahedral iron(II) complexes to predict spin-state energy gaps.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OrbGNN，一种基于电子结构图架构的机器学习模型，通过将轨道间相互作用表示为图结构、轨道纠缠编码连接性，将轨道相关度量信息嵌入图拓扑，实现对电子性质和静态电子相关效应的预测。模型在氮气解离、双原子分子数据集及八面体铁(II)配合物自旋态能隙预测中进行了评估。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习原子间势能（MLIPs）虽然能够高效准确地预测结构、热力学和动力学性质，但由于缺乏电子结构信息，在电子性质预测和静态电子相关效应方面存在局限性，需要一种能够捕捉电子结构信息的模型架构。
AI.method: 提出OrbGNN架构，类比分子图和MLIP框架：以轨道对（pair-orbital）相互作用构建图表示，用轨道纠缠编码轨道间连接性，并将轨道相关度量信息直接嵌入图拓扑结构，形成分子轨道景观和电子相关模式的紧凑表示。
AI.result: 通过特征空间行为分析证明了轨道图模型的鲁棒性；模型在氮气解离和更大双原子分子数据集上进行了评估，并成功应用于预测八面体铁(II)配合物的自旋态能隙。
AI.conclusion: OrbGNN通过将电子结构信息纳入图神经网络框架，弥补了传统MLIPs在电子性质和静态电子相关效应预测方面的不足，为分子建模提供了更全面的工具。

title: Vectorized Symmetric and Fermionic Tensor Network Implementations for GPU-Accelerated Variational Monte Carlo
summary: Variational Monte Carlo (VMC) calculations based on tensor networks (TN) have recently achieved competitive accuracy in ground-state calculations of strongly correlated spin and fermionic systems. However, existing tensor network VMC (TN-VMC) algorithms have not been formulated in a manner that can fully utilize GPU acceleration. We tackle the key missing ingredient, namely, the vectorized evaluation of tensor network amplitudes and tensor network operations. This ensures high GPU utilization by batching over computations with identical structure. In particular, we show how to achieve vectorization for the practically relevant case of abelian symmetric tensor networks (which includes fermionic tensor networks) by developing a ``flat'' tensor network formalism for block-sparse tensor representation and contraction. Using this, we construct a GPU-adapted symmetric TN-VMC workflow with batched tensor network computation. In the two-dimensional Fermi--Hubbard model, we demonstrate a GPU speedup of up to $300 \times$ over single core CPU implementations, for fermionic TN variational wavefunctions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对GPU加速的对称张量网络变分蒙特卡洛（TN-VMC）算法，通过开发"平坦"张量网络形式来向量化块稀疏张量的表示与缩并，实现批量化计算，在二维Fermi-Hubbard模型中相比单核CPU实现了高达300倍的GPU加速。
AI.motivation: 现有的张量网络VMC算法未能充分利用GPU加速能力，关键缺失在于张量网络幅值和操作的向量化求值。对于包含阿贝尔对称性（如费米子张量网络）的实际场景，需要一种能够实现高GPU利用率的批量化计算方法。
AI.method: 开发了一种"平坦"张量网络形式用于块稀疏张量表示与缩并，实现了阿贝尔对称张量网络的向量化操作。通过批处理结构相同的计算来确保高GPU利用率，并构建了GPU适配的对称TN-VMC工作流程，其中包含批量化张量网络计算。
AI.result: 在二维Fermi-Hubbard模型中，使用费米子张量网络变分波函数，实现了相比单核CPU实现最高达300倍的GPU加速。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了TN-VMC在GPU向量化方面的空白，为强关联自旋和费米子系统的基态计算提供了高效的GPU加速方案，使对称张量网络VMC方法能够充分利用现代GPU硬件的大规模并行计算能力。

title: Topological signatures in the quench dynamics of periodically driven quantum systems
summary: We study the quench dynamics of graphene, without and with a staggered mass, following the sudden switch-on of circularly polarized light where coupling to a fermionic bath is also considered. Using an armchair nanoribbon, we compute the period-averaged bond current near the edge at successive stroboscopic times. For the isolated system, the current oscillates around a dc value which, we analytically show, equals the Floquet band currents weighted by their projected occupations; a nonzero dc current signals an induced topological phase. When coupled to a bath with a finite coupling, the current and conductance initially increase and then saturate, indicating a nonequilibrium steady state. In the limit of vanishingly small coupling, the period-averaged conductance becomes quantized after summing over bath chemical potentials shifted by integer multiples of the driving frequency, revealing the number of edge modes crossing the zero-quasienergy gap and the Floquet zone boundary gap. We support these results by computing the two-terminal conductance of a finite-size tight-binding model under a three-step driving protocol; the bond conductance after applying the sum rule corroborates our findings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了石墨烯在圆偏振光突然开启后的淬火动力学，包括有无交错质量以及费米子浴耦合的情况。利用扶手椅纳米带，计算了连续频闪时间下边缘附近的周期平均键电流。结果显示，孤立系统中电流围绕直流值振荡（该值等于Floquet能带电流按投影占据加权），非零直流电流标志着诱导拓扑相。耦合浴后电流和电导先增后饱和，形成非平衡稳态；在趋于零耦合极限下，周期平均电导在求和规则后量子化，揭示穿过零准能隙和Floquet区边界隙的边缘模式数。
AI.motivation: 理解Floquet驱动系统中拓扑相变的动力学特征，特别是淬火后边缘电流的行为及其与拓扑性质的联系，并探究耗散环境对Floquet拓扑相的影响。
AI.method: 采用扶手椅石墨烯纳米带模型，通过突然开启圆偏振光的淬火协议，计算周期平均键电流和电导。对孤立系统进行解析推导，将直流电流与Floquet能带电流的投影占据加权相关联；对耦合浴系统分析非平衡稳态，并在弱耦合极限下应用化学势求和规则提取量子化的电导。通过三步驱动协议下的有限尺寸紧束缚模型双端电导计算验证结果。
AI.result: 孤立系统中直流电流非零标志着诱导拓扑相的涌现；耦合浴时电流和电导达到饱和稳态；弱耦合极限下电导经求和规则后量子化，数值模拟与解析结果一致。
AI.conclusion: Floquet驱动下边缘电流的直流分量可有效表征诱导拓扑相，且耗散耦合不会破坏其拓扑特征，弱耦合极限下的量子化电导揭示了边缘模式在零准能隙和Floquet区边界隙中的穿越数量。

title: Bound state of a He-3 atom at free He-4 surfaces
summary: Quantum Monte Carlo simulations confirm the existence of a bound state of a single He-3 atom at a free superfluid He-4 surface in three dimensions, localized within a ~10-A thick low-density He-4 surface layer, with a binding energy of approximately 4 K with respect to vacuum. As the temperature is raised above ~ 1 K the He-3 atom leaves the surface to dissolve into the superfluid. The situation is entirely different in two dimensions, as the He-3 atom is excluded from the superfluid and no surface bound state exists. Results are also presented for the a He-3 atom binding to nanoscale size He-4 clusters adsorbed on weak substrates, a physical system that may allow for the observation of some of the physics predicted for extended surfaces. It is shown that a He-3 bound state localized at the perimeter of sufficiently small (a few tens of atoms) clusters exists not just on Cs, as previously reported, but on all alkali substrates.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过量子蒙特卡洛模拟研究了He-3原子在超流He-4表面及纳米团簇上的束缚态行为。研究发现：三维情形下He-3原子在He-4表面存在束缚态（结合能约4K），温度升至1K以上时会溶解进超流体；二维情形下He-3原子被排除且无表面束缚态；He-3原子能在所有碱金属基底上的小He-4团簇外围形成束缚态。
AI.motivation: 探究He-3原子在超流He-4表面及受限体系中的量子束缚态行为，理解维度效应（2D vs 3D）对这类物理系统的影响，并探索扩展到纳米尺度团簇体系的新物理现象。
AI.method: 采用量子蒙特卡洛模拟方法，研究He-3原子在自由He-4超流表面（三维）、二维超流体系以及吸附在弱基底上的纳米尺度He-4团簇上的束缚态行为。
AI.result: 三维情况下He-3在He-4表面约10Å厚的低密度表面层中形成束缚态，结合能约4K；温度超过1K时He-3离开表面溶解进超流体。二维情况下He-3被超流排除，不存在表面束缚态。此外，He-3在所有碱金属基底上的小He-4团簇（几十个原子）外围均存在束缚态，而不仅限于Cs基底。
AI.conclusion: 量子蒙特卡洛模拟揭示了He-3在He-4超流表面束缚态的维度依赖性（3D存在、2D不存在），并证明纳米团簇体系可成为观测扩展表面物理的替代平台，且束缚态在不同碱金属基底上普遍存在。

title: Gauge invariance, collective modes, and the justification of normal-state subtraction in Dirac superconductors
summary: In Dirac superconductors, the unbounded spectrum of low-energy Dirac models is known to give rise to unphysical interband contributions from deep-lying states to the electromagnetic response. To eliminate these contributions, normal-state subtraction (NSS), in which the normal-state response is subtracted from the superconducting-state response, has been widely employed. However, the relation between NSS and a gauge-invariant electromagnetic response, particularly the role of the vertex correction required by the Ward identity, has remained unclear. In this work, we consider a massive-Dirac model with $s$-wave pairing and analytically investigate the electromagnetic response at zero temperature by solving the Bethe--Salpeter equation and incorporating the collective-mode contribution to the electromagnetic vertex. We show that, in the static long-wavelength limit, the vertex correction exactly cancels the bare longitudinal response with NSS, yielding the vanishing longitudinal response required by gauge invariance. In contrast, the transverse component of the vertex correction vanishes in the long-wavelength limit, so that the gauge-invariant Meissner weight coincides with that obtained from the bare transverse response with NSS. Moreover, within the class of isotropic and analytic UV regularization terms, we show that gauge invariance uniquely fixes the regularization term in the static long-wavelength limit to the value prescribed by NSS. Our results thus provide a microscopic justification for NSS.

AI.tldr: 本文通过解析求解Bethe-Salpeter方程并加入集体模对电磁顶点的贡献，研究了具有s波配对的massive-Dirac模型在零温下的电磁响应，证明在静态长波极限下顶点修正与裸纵向响应（含NSS）精确抵消，从而满足规范不变性要求的消失的纵向响应；而横向顶点修正在此极限下为零，规范不变的Meissner权重与NSS裸横向响应一致，从而为NSS提供了微观层面的理论依据。
AI.motivation: Dirac超导体中低能Dirac模型的无界谱会导致深能级态对电磁响应产生非物理的带间贡献。为消除这些贡献，广泛采用正常态扣除（NSS）方法，但NSS与规范不变的电磁响应之间的关系，特别是Ward恒等式所要求的顶点修正的作用，一直不清楚。本文旨在阐明这一关系。
AI.method: 考虑具有s波配对的massive-Dirac模型，通过在零温下解析求解Bethe-Salpeter方程，并将集体模（collective-mode）贡献纳入电磁顶点，系统地分析电磁响应，并在各向同性解析的紫外正则化类别内检验规范不变性对正则化项的约束。
AI.result: 在静态长波极限下：1）顶点修正精确抵消裸纵向响应（含NSS），使纵向响应为零，满足规范不变性要求；2）横向顶点修正在长波极限下消失，规范不变的Meissner权重与NSS得到的裸横向响应一致；3）在各向同性解析紫外正则化项类别中，规范不变性唯一地固定了静态长波极限下的正则化项，其取值恰为NSS所规定的值。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果为NSS提供了微观层面的严格理论依据，表明NSS不仅是消除非物理带间贡献的经验方法，而且与规范不变的电磁响应理论自洽一致。

title: Spin-Selective Spectral Flattening and Wave-Packet Dynamics in a Flux-Engineered Lieb Lattice
summary: We investigate reversible internal-state-selective wave-packet transport induced by spin-dependent Peierls phases in a two-dimensional nearest-neighbor Lieb lattice. The two conserved spin components experience effective fluxes $α_σ=α_{0}+s_σα_{s}$, where $s_{\uparrow,\downarrow}=\pm1$. At the working point $α_{0}=α_{s}=1/4$, the spin-up and spin-down components experience $α_{\uparrow}=1/2$ and $α_{\downarrow}=0$, respectively. A band-resolved calculation in the $q=2$ magnetic unit cell shows that the spin-up spectrum contains two zero-energy flat subbands associated with the sublattice-imbalance flat-band sector, whereas the remaining four subbands retain finite bandwidths. The half-flux sector therefore fails the all-bands-flat condition and does not realize exact Aharonov--Bohm caging for a generic localized initial state. Nevertheless, real-time simulations reveal a pronounced suppression of spin-up propagation relative to the dispersive spin-down component, manifested by a smaller mean-square displacement and an enhanced finite-region retention probability over the pre-reflection time window. Reversing the state-dependent flux interchanges the slow and fast spin channels, while the dynamical contrast remains robust against moderate flux detuning. These results establish spin-dependent synthetic flux as a reversible means of controlling internal-state-resolved matter-wave transport without spin-flip processes or interactions, and provide complementary spectral and real-space criteria for distinguishing exact caging from finite-time dynamical slowing in atomic and photonic flat-band simulators.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了二维近邻Lieb晶格中由自旋依赖的Peierls相位诱导的可逆内态选择波包输运。在特定工作点下，自旋向上和向下分量分别经历半通量（α↑=1/2）和零通量（α↓=0），导致自旋向上传播显著受抑，而自旋向下色散传播。研究区分了精确Aharonov-Bohm笼与有限时间动力学减速，提出了互补的谱与实空间判据。
AI.motivation: 探索利用自旋依赖的人工合成通量（spin-dependent synthetic flux）作为可逆手段，实现对内态分辨物质波输运的调控。已有研究多关注自旋无关的通量或全带平坦条件，本文则关注在半通量扇区"非全带平坦"条件下是否仍能实现输运抑制，并区分精确笼囚与有限时间动力学减速的差异。
AI.method: 采用q=2磁性原胞进行能带分辨计算，分析自旋向上和向下分量各自的能带结构；通过实时数值模拟计算均方位移（mean-square displacement）和有限区域保留概率（retention probability），对比两个自旋通道在不同通量配置下的动力学行为。
AI.result: 在α0=αs=1/4工作点，自旋向上分量经历半通量，其谱包含两个零能平坦子带，但其余四个子带具有有限带宽，不满足全带平坦条件，因此无法对一般局域初态实现精确AB笼。然而，实时模拟显示自旋向上传播显著受抑（均方位移更小、保留概率更高），反转通量可互换快慢自旋通道，且对中等通量失谐具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 自旋依赖合成通量可作为无需自旋翻转或相互作用的可逆手段控制内态分辨输运，并提供了区分精确笼囚与有限时间动力学减速的谱与实空间互补判据，对原子和光子平坦带模拟器具有参考价值。

title: Resolving Spin-Phonon Relaxation Pathways in Molecular Qubits via Regularized Regression
summary: Designing molecular qubits requires controlling the spin-lattice relaxation pathways that fundamentally limit the coherence time. For spin-1/2 molecular qubits, significant discrepancies remain between theoretical predictions and experimental measurements of spin-phonon relaxation pathways, with theory often overestimating the role of low-frequency vibrational modes. Here, we present an alternative first-principles approach augmented with regularized regression that identifies spin-phonon relaxation pathways in an automated fashion without ad hoc mode selection. Applied to Cu porphyrins spin-1/2 molecular qubits, the method successfully reproduces experimental trends in relaxation times and predicts the curvature in the relaxation-vs-temperature profile. The g-tensor time series reveal distinct system-specific autocorrelation functions and spectral-density profiles despite the qubits' structural similarity. Further, regression between g-tensor time series and mode-projected vibrational-amplitude time series obtained from molecular dynamics yields linear and bilinear mode coupling contributions to each g-tensor component. Because the method is based on atomic displacements sampled directly from molecular dynamics, it naturally incorporates anharmonic effects and does not require the harmonic approximation. This framework puts forward a regression-driven, mode-resolved, and coupling-order-separated spin-phonon analysis as a general strategy for predicting and engineering longer-lived molecular qubits.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于正则化回归的第一性原理方法，用于自动识别分子量子比特中的自旋-声子弛豫路径，无需人工选择振动模式。该方法应用于Cu卟啉自旋-1/2分子量子比特，成功重现了实验弛豫时间趋势和弛豫-温度曲线的曲率，并通过分子动力学采样的原子位移自然包含了非谐效应。
AI.motivation: 设计分子量子比特需要控制限制相干时间的自旋-晶格弛豫路径。然而，自旋-1/2分子量子比特中自旋-声子弛豫路径的理论预测与实验测量之间存在显著差异，理论往往高估低频振动模式的作用，需要一种无需临时模式选择的自动化方法。
AI.method: 提出一种结合正则化回归的第一性原理方法，从分子动力学中提取g-张量时间序列和模式投影振动振幅时间序列，通过回归分析识别线性与双线性模式耦合对每个g-张量分量的贡献，自动化识别自旋-声子弛豫路径，无需谐波近似。
AI.result: 该方法成功重现了Cu卟啉分子量子比特的实验弛豫时间趋势，并预测了弛豫-温度关系的曲率。g-张量时间序列揭示了结构相似量子比特间不同的系统特异性自相关函数和谱密度分布，并获得了线性与双线性模式耦合贡献的分离。
AI.conclusion: 该框架提出了回归驱动、模式分辨、耦合阶数分离的自旋-声子分析方法，作为预测和工程化更长寿命分子量子比特的通用策略，天然纳入非谐效应且无需谐波近似。

title: Higher-Order Topological Phase in the Two-Dimensional Type-IV Magnet MgCr$_2$O$_4$
summary: Type-IV two-dimensional (2D) magnetism-a newly classified collinear magnetic phase featuring nonrelativistic spin degeneracy and spin-orbit-coupling-induced momentum-dependent spin splitting-extends the symmetry classification of collinear magnets, opening new opportunities for unconventional topological quantum states. Here, we reveal that the recently proposed two-dimensional type-IV 2D magnet MgCr$_2$O$_4$ hosts an intrinsic higher-order topological insulating phase, featuring $\mathcal{C}_{3z}$-protected corner states and a nontrivial rotational topological invariant of $χ^{(3)}$ = $\{-2,4\}$ with a quantized fractional corner charge of $4e/3$. Spin-orbit coupling breaks the spin-degeneracy-enforcing symmetry $[C_{2}||M_z]$ while preserving the crystalline $\mathcal{C}_{3z}$ rotational symmetry that protects the higher-order topological phase, thereby enabling spin splitting to coexist with the nontrivial topology. Furthermore, the higher-order topological phase remains intact throughout a wide range of biaxial strains without band-gap closing and topological phase transition, demonstrating the robustness of the symmetry-protected topological state against external perturbations. Our work establishes a direct connection between type-IV magnetic system and higher-order topology, providing a new route for symmetry-engineered magnetic topological quantum states.

AI.tldr: 本文揭示了二维IV型磁性材料MgCr₂O₄具有内在的高阶拓扑绝缘体相，具有C₃z保护的角态和非平凡的旋转拓扑不变量χ⁽³⁾={-2,4}，量子化分数角电荷为4e/3。自旋-轨道耦合打破了自旋简并对称性但保留了保护高阶拓扑的C₃z旋转对称性，使自旋劈裂与拓扑共存；该拓扑相在宽范围双轴应变下保持稳定。
AI.motivation: IV型二维磁性是一种新分类的共线磁相，具有非相对论自旋简并和自旋-轨道耦合诱导的动量依赖自旋劈裂，扩展了共线磁体的对称性分类，可能为非常规拓扑量子态开辟新机遇。本文旨在探索IV型磁体与高阶拓扑之间的内在联系。
AI.method: 以MgCr₂O₄这一二维IV型磁性材料为研究对象，通过第一性原理计算和拓扑分析，研究其高阶拓扑绝缘体相，包括计算旋转拓扑不变量χ⁽³⁾、分析角态和分数角电荷，并考察双轴应变对该拓扑相的稳定性影响。
AI.result: 发现MgCr₂O₄具有内在高阶拓扑绝缘体相：C₃z保护的角态、旋转拓扑不变量χ⁽³⁾={-2,4}、量子化分数角电荷4e/3。自旋-轨道耦合打破自旋简并对称性但保留拓扑保护对称性，使自旋劈裂与拓扑共存。宽范围双轴应变下拓扑相保持稳定，无带隙闭合和拓扑相变。
AI.conclusion: 本工作建立了IV型磁性系统与高阶拓扑之间的直接联系，为对称工程化的磁性拓扑量子态提供了新途径。

title: Atomistic Indicators of the Ductile-to-Brittle Transition in Polycrystalline Tungsten: Temperature and Rhenium Effects on Crack-Tip Plasticity
summary: The fracture response of body-centered-cubic tungsten is governed by competition between crack-tip instability and dislocation-mediated plastic accommodation. Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations are used to examine edge-cracked polycrystalline W and W-Re under displacement-controlled Mode-I tension from 300-1800 K at a strain rate of 5 x 10^8 s^-1. Heating pure W reduces the instability stress, effective specimen stiffness, and pre-instability volumetric work density, while the instability strain remains comparatively scattered. A normalized work-loss metric derived from the pre-instability work gives a broad sigmoid crossover marker, T*_MD ~ 870 K, characteristic of the simulated geometry and high-rate loading conditions. Among the available W-Re compositions, W-10Re shows greater pre-instability deformation and work accumulation than pure W across most temperatures, while the maximum-stress response remains strongly temperature- and composition-dependent. Changes in retained dislocation character and near-tip activity indicate that Re modifies the crack-tip plastic-accommodation pathway rather than producing a simple strength increase. Common-state analysis further shows that Re alters the retained 1/2<111> line character and the temporal distribution of near-tip dislocation activity without uniformly increasing the local dislocation population. These coupled mechanical and defect-structure changes provide atomistic indicators of a high-rate ductile-to-brittle transition (DBT), but not a direct prediction of experimental DBTT. A separate OpenDiS/pydis calculation demonstrates source-like bow-out and heterogeneous dislocation-network development in crack-free polycrystalline W, providing mesoscale context without implying direct quantitative MD-DDD coupling.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分子动力学（MD）模拟研究了多晶钨（W）和钨-铼（W-Re）合金在位移控制I型拉伸下的断裂响应，温度范围为300-1800 K。研究发现加热纯W会降低失稳应力、有效刚度和失稳前体积功密度，并识别出约870 K的韧脆转变交叉标记。W-10Re增强了失稳前变形和功积累，Re通过改变裂纹尖端塑性容纳路径而非简单增强强度来影响断裂行为。
AI.motivation: 理解体心立方钨的断裂响应由裂纹尖端失稳与位错介导塑性容纳之间的竞争所支配的机制，探索Re合金化如何影响W的韧脆转变行为，为高应变率下的DBT提供原子尺度指标。
AI.method: 采用分子动力学（MD）模拟，对带边缘裂纹的多晶W和W-Re在300-1800 K温度下、5×10^8 s^-1应变率进行位移控制Mode-I拉伸模拟；使用归一化功损失度量识别韧脆转变交叉标记；结合缺陷结构分析和OpenDiS/pydis准位错动力学计算提供介观尺度背景。
AI.result: 加热降低了失稳应力、有效刚度和失稳前体积功密度；归一化功损失度量给出T*_MD约870 K的S形交叉标记；W-10Re在大多数温度下表现出更大的失稳前变形和功积累；Re改变保留的1/2<111>线特征和近尖端位错活动的时间分布，但未均匀增加局部位错群体。
AI.conclusion: Re合金化改变了裂纹尖端塑性容纳路径而非简单增加强度；这些耦合的力学和缺陷结构变化提供了高应变率DBT的原子尺度指标，但不能直接预测实验DBTT；OpenDiS/pydis计算提供介观背景但不暗示直接的MD-DDD定量耦合。

title: The thermodynamic freedom of a thermodynamic computer
summary: Thermodynamic computers are stochastic physical devices designed to perform calculations at the thermal energy scale. Their operation is constrained by the equations of stochastic thermodynamics, among which are a set of bounds, known as speed limits, that relate a thermodynamic computer's run time to its computational progress and the heat it dissipates. Using the Wasserstein speed limit we assess the thermodynamic efficiency of a simulation model of a thermodynamic computer trained to perform a standard machine-learning classification task. On this task the thermodynamic computer is as capable as a simple multilayer perceptron. We show that different inference protocols allow the computer to operate within 40\% of the thermodynamic limit of efficiency without loss of accuracy, or to perform inference increasingly rapidly at fixed accuracy and thermodynamic efficiency. These results indicate that a thermodynamic computer designed for a particular task retains considerable freedom in its thermodynamic operation.

AI.tldr: 本文研究热力学计算机的能源效率，利用Wasserstein速度极限评估其执行机器学习分类任务时的热力学效率，发现不同推理协议可使计算机在保持精度的前提下接近热力学极限效率的40%，或在固定精度和效率下加速推理。
AI.motivation: 热力学计算机是工作在热能尺度上的随机物理设备，其运行受随机热力学方程约束，其中包括将运行时间与计算进展和热耗散联系起来的"速度极限"界限。作者希望评估热力学计算机在实际机器学习任务中的热力学效率，并探索其在保持性能的同时是否具有运行灵活性。
AI.method: 使用Wasserstein速度极限作为评估工具，构建一个热力学计算机的仿真模型，并训练其执行标准机器学习分类任务（与简单多层感知机对比）。通过设计不同的推理协议，分析热力学效率、精度和推理速度之间的权衡关系。
AI.result: 热力学计算机在分类任务上与简单多层感知机能力相当。不同推理协议允许计算机在保持精度的前提下，运行在热力学极限效率的40%以内；或者在固定精度和热力学效率下实现越来越快的推理。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，为特定任务设计的热力学计算机在其热力学运行方式上保留了相当大的自由度，可以在效率与速度之间进行灵活权衡，而不会牺牲计算精度。

title: A Three-Fluid Model of Dissipation at Surfaces in Superconducting Radiofrequency Cavities
summary: Experiments on superconducting cavities have found that under large RF fields the quality factor can improve with increasing field amplitude, a so-called ``anti-Q slope.'' We numerically solve the Bogoliubov-de Gennes equations at a superconducting surface in a parallel magnetic field, finding at large fields there are surface quasiparticle states with energies below the bulk superconducting gap that emerge and disappear as the field cycles. Modifying the standard two-fluid model, we introduce a ``three''-fluid model where we partition the normal fluid to consider continuum and surface quasiparticle states separately. We compute dissipation in a semi-classical theory of conductivity, where we provide physical estimates of elastic scattering times of Bogoliubov quasiparticles with point-like impurities having potential strengths informed from complementary \textit{ab initio} calculations of impurities in bulk niobium. We show, in this simple yet effective framework, how the relative scattering rates of surface and continuum quasiparticle states can play a role in producing an anti-Q slope while demonstrating how this model naturally includes a mechanism for turning the anti-Q slope on and off.

AI.tldr: 本文通过数值求解超导表面的Bogoliubov-de Gennes方程，发现在大射频场下存在能量低于体超导能隙的表面准粒子态，并提出一种"三流体"模型（将正常流体划分为连续态和表面准粒子态）结合半经典电导理论，解释超导腔中观察到的"反Q斜率"现象。
AI.motivation: 实验发现超导腔在大射频场下品质因数随场幅增大而改善（"反Q斜率"），这一现象与标准理论预期相悖，缺乏合理解释机制。
AI.method: 1) 数值求解Bogoliubov-de Gennes方程研究超导表面在平行磁场中的准粒子态；2) 提出"三流体"模型，将正常流体分为连续态和表面准粒子态两部分；3) 利用半经典电导理论计算耗散，结合从头算（ab initio）计算得到铌中杂质弹性散射时间的物理估计。
AI.result: 该模型展示表面准粒子态与连续态的相对散射率可以在产生反Q斜率中发挥作用，并且该模型自然地包含了一种开启和关闭反Q斜率的机制。
AI.conclusion: 这个简单而有效的框架表明，考虑表面态与连续态的不同散射特性能够解释超导腔中的反Q斜率现象，为理解高场下超导射频性能提供了新的理论视角。

title: Turning Zeeman splitting into switchable charge polarization in a double quantum dot
summary: A magnetic field that acts identically on two quantum dots is not expected to move charge between them. Nevertheless, we show that a uniform Zeeman field can strongly reconfigure and even reverse the single-electron charge polarization of an asymmetric open double quantum dot. Using a symmetry-preserving Green's-function equation-of-motion approach, we identify regimes where the preferred dot occupation reverses while the system remains in the single-electron charge sector. Two distinct mechanisms produce this behavior. Unequal gate levels produce different occupation responses because the Zeeman-shifted resonances lie at different positions relative to the reservoir chemical potential, whereas unequal onsite interactions distinguish the dots through their many-body addition spectra. Coulomb blockade stabilizes the single-electron sector, causing the reservoir-mediated response to appear as spatial charge redistribution rather than a change in total occupation. Our results establish a mechanism for magnetic control of charge polarization at fixed electrostatic detuning.

AI.tldr: 本文发现均匀Zeeman磁场可以强烈重构甚至反转非对称开放双量子点的单电子电荷极化，尽管磁场对两个量子点作用相同、理论上不应引起电荷转移。通过保持对称性的Green函数运动方程方法，作者确认了在系统保持单电子电荷扇区的情况下，两个不同的机制（不等栅极能级和不等在位相互作用）可导致点占据反转。库仑阻塞稳定单电子扇区，使储库介导的响应表现为空间电荷重新分布而非总占据变化。该研究建立了在固定静电失谐下磁性控制电荷极化的机制。
AI.motivation: 传统上认为均匀磁场对两个量子点作用相同，不应移动它们之间的电荷。作者挑战这一直觉，探索均匀Zeeman场是否以及如何能重新配置开放双量子点的电荷极化，从而建立磁控电荷极化的新机制。
AI.method: 采用保持对称性的Green函数运动方程方法，分析非对称开放双量子点系统。通过考察两种机制：（1）不等栅极能级使得Zeeman位移后的共振位置相对储库化学势不同；（2）不等在位相互作用通过多体附加谱区分两个量子点。结合库仑阻塞效应稳定单电子电荷扇区。
AI.result: 识别出两种可使点占据反转的机制，且系统始终保持在单电子电荷扇区。库仑阻塞将储库介导的响应转化为空间电荷重新分布，而非总占据变化。
AI.conclusion: 建立了均匀磁场在固定静电失谐下控制电荷极化的机制，证明了均匀Zeeman场即使对两个量子点作用相同，仍可通过非对称系统参数实现电荷极化的磁性控制，为量子点器件的磁性调控提供了新途径。

title: Field-tuned quasiparticles and electronic structure in heavy-fermion YbNi4P2
summary: We study the Fermi surface topology and quasiparticle properties in the heavy fermion compound YbNi4P2 at high magnetic fields using quantum oscillation measurements. We observe a large decrease of the quasiparticle mass with increasing field and demonstrate good qualitative agreement with the single-ion Kondo model. At the putative Lifshitz transition at 17 T, we observe a sudden change of quantum oscillation frequencies suggesting an abrupt change of the electronic structure and/or quasiparticle characteristics. Our results demonstrate the ability to tune the electronic structure and provide input for theoretical models of YbNi4P2 and correlated electron systems in high magnetic fields.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过量子振荡测量，探究了重费米子化合物YbNi4P2在高磁场下的费米面拓扑和准粒子性质，发现准粒子质量随磁场显著降低，并与单离子Kondo模型定性吻合。在17 T处疑似Lifshitz转变点观察到量子振荡频率的突变，表明电子结构和/或准粒子特性发生急剧变化。
AI.motivation: 理解重费米子化合物在高磁场下的电子结构和准粒子行为，验证单离子Kondo模型，并为YbNi4P2及相关强关联电子系统提供理论建模的输入。
AI.method: 采用量子振荡（quantum oscillation）测量技术，在高磁场条件下研究YbNi4P2的费米面拓扑和准粒子性质。
AI.result: 观察到准粒子质量随磁场增大而大幅下降，与单离子Kondo模型定性一致；在17 T处（疑似Lifshitz转变）观测到量子振荡频率的突然变化，暗示电子结构或准粒子特性发生突变。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明可以通过磁场调控电子结构，并为YbNi4P2及高磁场下强关联电子系统的理论研究提供了关键实验数据。

title: Mode-Specific Dynamics of CO2 Hydrogenation on Copper: The Hidden Role of Molecular Rotation
summary: Catalytic hydrogenation of CO2 to formate on copper is a key elementary step for CO2 utilization. Previous experimental and theoretical studies suggested an Eley-Rideal mechanism for this reaction, promoted by bending vibrational excitation, yet direct state resolved evidence remains lacking. Here, we present accurate dynamical predictions for CO2 hydrogenation on Cu(111) based on a full-dimensional first-principles neural network potential energy surface. Our calculations near-quantitatively reproduce the measured reaction probabilities, including their nozzle-temperature and incidence-energy dependence. Our state-resolved results indicate that while vibrational excitation of the bending mode enhances reactivity, it alone cannot account for the observed reactivity increase with nozzle temperature. Instead, rotational excitation plays a dominant role, mainly attributable to the significant change in anisotropy of the molecular polar orientation as CO2 accesses the transition state. This mode-specific mechanistic insight revises the conventional interpretation and lays the foundation for the precise control of CO2 hydrogenation on catalysts.

AI.tldr: 本文通过全维第一性原理神经网络势能面，对Cu(111)上CO2催化加氢生成甲酸盐的反应进行了精确动力学预测，证实旋转激发在反应中起主导作用，而非传统认为的弯曲振动激发，从而修正了对该反应的机理认识。
AI.motivation: Cu表面CO2加氢生成甲酸盐是CO2利用的关键基元步骤，但以往研究缺乏态分辨的直接证据来验证Eley-Rideal机理和弯曲振动激发的促进作用，需要更精确的动力学预测来澄清机理。
AI.method: 构建全维第一性原理神经网络势能面，并进行精确的量子动力学计算，模拟CO2在Cu(111)表面的加氢反应，分析不同振动/转动激发态对反应概率的贡献。
AI.result: 计算结果近定量地再现了实验测量的反应概率及其对喷嘴温度和入射能量的依赖；发现弯曲振动激发虽能增强反应活性，但无法单独解释喷嘴温度升高导致的活性增加，旋转激发才是主导因素。
AI.conclusion: 旋转激发主导CO2加氢反应活性，其机制与CO2接近过渡态时分子极性取向的各向异性显著变化有关，该态分辨机理洞察修正了传统解释，为催化剂上CO2加氢的精确控制奠定基础。

title: Accelerated S-NFC for Million-Chaff RCS Computation Using Low-Rank Compression of Concatenated Block Rows
summary: Sparsification via neglecting far-field coupling (S-NFC) enables fast full-wave radar-cross-section analysis of large-scale chaff clouds by retaining only significant local electromagnetic interactions. This letter further accelerates S-NFC by concatenating the retained off-diagonal interaction blocks associated with each receiving chaff element and applying a joint low-rank factorization with a shared receiving-side basis. Exact self interactions are preserved, while repeated chaff templates reuse precomputed lower--upper factorizations of the self-interaction blocks. The compressed formulation reduces retained-coupling storage and matrix--vector multiplication cost and also decreases the number of iterations required by the generalized conjugate residual solver. Numerical tests with 100,000 chaff elements demonstrate sub-$1\%$ complex-far-field error for low-rank approximations in sparse regimes and identify a practical self-only limit at sufficiently large mean spacing. For a one-million-chaff plume, the proposed compressed S-NFC achieves a $6.92\times$ end-to-end speedup over uncompressed S-NFC while storing only $6.60\%$ of the retained coupling, with a complex-far-field error of $0.253\%$.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种压缩稀疏近场耦合（S-NFC）方法，通过拼接保留的离对角交互块并进行共享接收侧基的低秩分解，加速大规模箔条云的快速全波雷达散射截面分析。该方法显著降低了存储和计算成本，在100万箔条云测试中实现了6.92倍端到端加速，存储仅占原始保留耦合的6.60%，复远场误差仅0.253%。
AI.motivation: 传统S-NFC方法通过忽略远场耦合实现大规模箔条云的快速全波RCS分析，但保留的离对角耦合块仍占用大量存储和计算资源，限制了其在超大规模（如百万级箔条）场景下的效率。
AI.method: 将每个接收箔条元素相关的保留离对角交互块进行拼接，应用共享接收侧基的联合低秩分解；保留精确自交互项；对重复箔条模板复用预计算的自我交互块LU分解；采用压缩公式降低保留耦合的存储和矩阵-向量乘法成本，并减少广义共轭残差求解器的迭代次数。
AI.result: 在100,000箔条元测试中，稀疏体制下低秩近似的复远场误差低于1%；在一百万箔条羽流测试中，压缩S-NFC相对未压缩版本实现6.92倍端到端加速，仅存储6.60%的保留耦合，复远场误差为0.253%；同时在高平均间距下识别出自交互极限的实际边界。
AI.conclusion: 压缩S-NFC方法通过联合低秩因子化有效加速大规模箔条云的全波RCS分析，在保持高精度的同时大幅降低存储和计算开销，为超大规模电磁散射分析提供了实用且高效的解决方案。

title: Physics-informed learning for the inverse problem in resonant ultrasound spectroscopy
summary: Inferring elastic constants from resonant ultrasound spectra is a nonlinear and typically overdetermined inverse problem based on finite spectral data. We formulate the Rayleigh-Ritz inverse problem as a constrained inverse-isospectral problem on the set of physically admissible elasticity tensors. This induces effective low-dimensional variables for the inverse map on the admissible elasticity manifold: length and elastic scales, aspect-ratio coordinates, scale-free spectral features, and stability-respecting elastic ratios. We use these variables to construct a physics-informed learning pipeline in which a regression model acts only on reduced spectral and geometric features, while scale recovery and final elastic-constant reconstruction are imposed analytically. For the full cubic benchmark, the reconstructed constants have MAE values of $20.37(35.15)$, $24.30(41.33)$, and $2.13(3.66)~\mathrm{GPa}$ for $C_{11}$, $C_{12}$, and $C_{44}$. In the fixed-geometry benchmark, the corresponding cubic MAPE values are $4.14(3.87)\%$, $8.31(8.50)\%$, and $2.44(2.86)\%$, while the isotropic values are $4.0(3.6)\%$ and $0.4(0.3)\%$ for the bulk and shear moduli. The inverse problem then becomes a constrained regression problem in variables adapted to the geometry, scaling, crystal symmetry, and thermodynamic stability of Hookean elasticity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于物理信息的机器学习管线，用于从共振超声谱反演弹性常数。通过将Rayleigh-Ritz逆问题形式化为约束逆-等谱问题，在物理可容许的弹性张量流形上引入有效低维变量（长度和弹性尺度、长宽比坐标、无尺度谱特征和稳定性弹性比），使回归模型仅处理降维的谱与几何特征，而尺度恢复和最终弹性常数重建通过解析方式施加。在立方晶系基准任务中取得了良好的精度。
AI.motivation: 从共振超声谱推断弹性常数是一个非线性且通常超定的逆问题，基于有限谱数据。现有的反演方法缺乏对物理可容许性（如热力学稳定性、晶体对称性）的系统性约束，导致反演不稳定或产生非物理结果。作者希望通过将问题结构化地映射到物理可行的弹性张量流形上，从而提升反演的鲁棒性和准确性。
AI.method: 1) 将Rayleigh-Ritz逆问题形式化为可容许弹性张量集合上的约束逆-等谱问题；2) 在可容许弹性流形上引入有效低维变量：长度和弹性尺度、长宽比坐标、无尺度谱特征、稳定性弹性比；3) 构建物理信息学习管线：回归模型仅作用于降维的谱和几何特征，尺度恢复和弹性常数重建由解析方式完成。
AI.conclusion: 该逆问题被转化为一个在适应几何、尺度、晶体对称性和Hookean弹性热力学稳定性的变量空间中的约束回归问题，从而将物理约束与分析可解部分嵌入学习框架，减少了模型需要学习的自由度，提高了反演精度与物理可解释性。

title: Correlated disorder versus correlated noise: Ordering in active systems
summary: Can quenched disorder generate ordering in driven systems? Using a recently proposed hydrodynamic model, we show that sufficiently long-ranged quenched disorder can induce long-range order in two-dimensional (2D) nonreciprocal XY systems, even when the clean system exhibits only short-range order at finite noise. Active surfaces tangentially advected by quenched velocities, governed by the same hydrodynamic equation, become statistically flat with super- or subdiffusive relaxation. In three dimensions (3D), quenched disorder combined with nonreciprocity produces a novel transition between strong-coupling and asymptotically noninteracting regimes, supporting either long- or short-range order. In both 2D and 3D, the exponents are nonuniversal, which vary continuously with the degree of transversality of the quenched disorder. The degree of transversality of the quenched disorder can be tuned to induce transitions in the model for fixed disorder and noise variances.

AI.tldr: 本文研究淬火无序（quenched disorder）能否在驱动系统中诱导有序。通过流体动力学模型，发现足够长程的淬火无序可以在二维非互易XY系统中诱导长程有序，即使清洁系统在有限噪声下仅有短程有序。在三维中，淬火无序与非互易性结合会产生强耦合与渐近非相互作用区域之间的新型转变。指数是非普适的，随淬火无序的横向度连续变化。
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为无序通常会破坏有序，但本文探讨了淬火无序在驱动系统中反而可能"诱导"有序这一反直觉问题。作者旨在理解非互易XY系统在存在淬火无序时的有序性行为，以及在更高维度下的相变机制。
AI.method: 采用近期提出的流体动力学模型，分析二维和三维非互易XY系统中淬火无序的影响。通过理论分析研究系统在不同维度和无序强度下的有序性、界面平整度、弛豫动力学及相变行为，重点考察无序横向度这一参数对临界指数的调控作用。
AI.result: (1) 2D中，充分长程的淬火无序能诱导长程有序，而清洁系统仅有短程有序；(2) 活性表面在淬火速度切向平流下变为统计平坦，具有超扩散或亚扩散弛豫；(3) 3D中淬火无序与非互易性结合产生新型强耦合到渐近非相互作用的转变，支持长程或短程有序；(4) 两个维度中的指数都非普适，连续依赖于无序的横向度；(5) 通过调节横向度可在固定无序和噪声方差下诱导模型中的转变。
AI.conclusion: 淬火无序确实可以在驱动系统中诱导有序，这与直觉相反。系统的行为高度依赖于淬火无序的几何特性（横向度），该参数可作为调控系统相变的可调参数。结果揭示了非互易性与淬火无序相互作用的新物理，并在2D和3D中均表现出非普适标度行为。

title: Subcritical bifurcation and on-off bistability in ballistic polariton condensates
summary: Dynamics of exciton-polariton condensates under continuous-wave incoherent Gaussian optical pumping is considered. It is shown that the conventional supercritical Stuart-Landau picture is invalid in a certain domain of the parameter space. For strong polariton repulsion from the reservoir and relatively small pump spots, the dynamics is adequately described by the quintic Stuart-Landau equation. The corresponding subcritical pitchfork bifurcation leads to condensate formation, accompanied by bistability between the trivial and nontrivial states over a finite pump-power range and a one-bit memory. Further increase of the repulsion parameter or decrease of the spot size breaks down the perturbative approach and leads to a peculiar self-trapping regime with complex dynamics. Experimental evidence of the emergence of the proposed behavior is provided. Our findings can be used to design polaritonic setups that exploit the predicted memory effect.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了连续波非相干高斯光泵浦下激子-极化激元凝聚体的动力学，发现传统的超临界Stuart-Landau图像在特定参数域失效。当极化激元与库的排斥作用较强且泵浦光斑较小时，系统由五次Stuart-Landau方程描述，产生次临界叉形分岔，导致凝聚体形成伴随双稳态和一位记忆效应。进一步增大排斥参数或减小光斑尺寸会破坏微扰方法，导致复杂的自俘获动力学。文章提供了实验证据并提出了利用该记忆效应的极化激元器件设计。
AI.motivation: 传统的超临界Stuart-Landau图像无法描述强排斥和较小泵浦光斑参数域下激子-极化激元凝聚体的动力学行为，需要更精确的理论框架来理解凝聚体形成机制及潜在的记忆功能。
AI.method: 通过对连续波非相干高斯光泵浦下激子-极化激元系统进行理论分析，推导出五次Stuart-Landau方程来描述次临界叉形分岔，并结合实验验证理论预测。
AI.result: 证明了在强库排斥和小泵浦光斑条件下，系统表现出次临界叉形分岔导致的凝聚体形成，伴随有限泵浦功率范围内的双稳态和一位记忆效应；更强参数下出现自俘获复杂动力学；提供了实验证据。
AI.conclusion: 该研究发现可用于设计利用预测记忆效应的极化激元器件，拓展了极化激元非线性光学和量子模拟应用的可能性。

title: Interaction corrections to topological density three-point functions in two-dimensional Fermi liquids: a coadjoint orbit perspective
summary:
Density three-point correlations are known to probe the topology of the Fermi sea in two-dimensional noninteracting systems. Here, we study how these correlations are modified by interactions using the coadjoint-orbit effective field theory. A key advantage of the coadjoint-orbit formulation is that it provides a systematic way to incorporate generalized Landau interactions in terms of bosonized degrees of freedom, mapping fermionic loop contributions onto simpler tree-level diagrams. We show that, for a general isotropic dispersion $ε(p)$, even at linear order in the generalized Landau interaction, $\mathcal{O}(\mathcal{F}^{(2,0)})$, there exists a contribution proportional to the band curvature $ε''(p_F)$ that changes the nonanalytic structure of the free density three-point correlation function.
  This contribution introduces a distinct nonanalytic structure beyond that found in either the noninteracting case or an interacting Galilean-invariant system, showing that interaction effects can modify the topology-detecting density three-point correlation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用coadjoint-orbit有效场论研究相互作用对二维无相互作用系统中密度三点关联函数的影响。研究表明，即使在线性阶广义Landau相互作用下，对于一般各向同性色散关系，存在正比于能带曲率ε''(p_F)的贡献，会改变自由密度三点关联函数的非解析结构，引入超越无相互作用情况或伽利略不变相互作用系统的新非解析结构。
AI.motivation: 密度三点关联函数被已知可用于探测二维无相互作用系统中费米海的拓扑性质。然而，相互作用如何影响这些关联函数及其拓扑探测能力尚不清楚。作者旨在研究相互作用如何修正密度三点关联函数，特别是能否改变其非解析结构和拓扑探测功能。
AI.method: 采用coadjoint-orbit有效场论方法，其优势在于能系统地纳入广义Landau相互作用（通过玻色子化自由度），将费米子圈贡献映射为更简单的树级图。作者考虑一般各向同性色散ε(p)，在线性阶广义Landau相互作用O(F^(2,0))下进行分析。
AI.result: 研究发现，对于一般各向同性色散关系，即使在线性阶广义Landau相互作用下，存在一个正比于能带曲率ε''(p_F)的贡献，该贡献改变了自由密度三点关联函数的非解析结构。这种非解析结构既不同于无相互作用情形，也不同于伽利略不变相互作用系统中的情形。
AI.conclusion: 相互作用可以修改用于探测拓扑的密度三点关联函数，其效应依赖于能带曲率。这表明在利用密度三点关联函数探测费米海拓扑时，必须考虑相互作用效应（特别是能带曲率相关的贡献），否则可能得到错误的拓扑判断。

title: Projected q-Shells for Nested Gausslet Bases
summary: Electronic-structure calculations require a finite representation of both the electronic wave functions and their Coulomb interaction. Conventional compact basis sets lead to a four-index interaction. Gausslet basis sets are one of a very small number of approaches that allow a much smaller two-index interaction, similar to a real-space grid, but with far fewer points. The continuing challenge in their development is reducing further the number of functions needed while maintaining high accuracy. Here we introduce projected q-shells (PQS), an improvement to the nested Cartesian gausslets of White and Lindsey. Their standard nesting construction divides a joining shell into disjoint faces, edges, and corners, reducing its polynomial completeness from order q to order q-2. PQS approximately restores the two lost orders. In terms of completeness, we prove that for an ideal, undistorted parent, the span of the PQS basis is equivalent to an overcomplete basis of overlapping patches. Coordinate distortions, which are always used in practice, harm this equivalence only slightly. The moment properties that allow two-index interactions also become inexact, even without distortion, but we show that the improvement in order more than makes up for this loss. For similar basis sizes, PQS gives smaller one-electron and interaction errors on small molecules, such as H2+, H2, and C2, than standard nesting. The improvement is largest for more compact bases with smaller q.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了投影q壳层（PQS）方法，它是White和Lindsey嵌套笛卡尔gausslet基组的改进。PQS通过近似恢复标准嵌套构造中因分裂成面、边、角而丢失的多项式完备性（从q阶恢复到q-2阶以上），从而在保持高精度的同时进一步减少基函数数量，使电子结构计算中的二指标相互作用更高效。
AI.motivation: 电子结构计算需要有限表示电子波函数及其库仑相互作用。传统紧凑基组需要四指标相互作用，而gausslet基组允许更小的二指标相互作用，类似实空间网格但点数更少。该领域的持续挑战是在保持高精度的同时进一步减少所需函数数量。
AI.method: 引入投影q壳层（PQS）方法。标准的嵌套构造将连接壳层划分为不相交的面、边和角，将多项式完备性从q阶降低到q-2阶。PQS近似恢复丢失的两个阶数。作者证明对于理想无畸变的母体，PQS基的跨度等价于重叠块的过完备基；实际使用中坐标畸变对该等价性仅有轻微影响。
AI.result: 在类似基组大小下，PQS在小分子（如H2+、H2和C2）上获得比标准嵌套更小的一电子和相互作用误差。对于较小q的紧凑基组，改进最为显著。虽然矩性质（允许二指标相互作用）即使无畸变也变得不精确，但阶数上的改进足以弥补这一损失。
AI.conclusion: PQS通过恢复标准嵌套构造中丢失的多项式完备性阶数，在保持二指标相互作用优点的同时提高了精度，对较小q的紧凑基组改进最大，是gausslet基组发展的重要进步。

title: A Synthetic Iterative Scheme for Non-Gray Phonon Boltzmann Transport Equation with Dual Relaxation Times
summary: Solving the non-gray Callaway phonon Boltzmann transport equation allows a dual-relaxation-time approximation of separate normal and resistive scatterings and resolving the mode-dependent spectrum. The conventional iterative scheme (CIS) for deterministic solutions avoids a monolithic phase-space inversion, but its collision-source iteration can become prohibitively slow at a large characteristic length of a material. Existing synthetic acceleration schemes address either non-gray single-relaxation models or gray dual-relaxation models, leaving mode-resolved dual-relaxation transport without a dedicated acceleration framework. We develop a general synthetic iterative scheme (GSIS) for the stationary, linearized, non-gray Callaway equation, where synthetic approximations for the normal-process pseudo-temperature and phonon drift velocity are provided by exact energy and quasi-momentum balance laws closed with first-order Chapman-Enskog constitutive relations and non-equilibrium terms evaluated from the kinetic solution. The resistive-process pseudo-temperature is retrieved from the two quantities. Each iteration couples an upwind nodal discontinuous Galerkin kinetic sweep and a hybridizable discontinuous Galerkin solution of the synthetic equations to achieve high-order spatial discretization. A branch- and frequency-resolved Fourier analysis identifies the deterioration of CIS and shows that the GSIS contraction factor remains bounded away from unity for the considered graphene material. Asymptotic analysis indicates that GSIS reduces to a consistent discretization of a Guyer-Krumhansl-like equation and Fourier's law of heat conduction in the hydrodynamic and diffusive limits, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文针对非灰Callaway声子玻尔兹曼方程，发展了一种通用的合成迭代方案（GSIS），通过精确的能量与准动量平衡律闭合的一阶Chapman-Enskog本构关系，提供合成近似以加速模式分辨的双弛豫时间输运求解，克服了传统迭代方案在大特征长度下的缓慢收敛问题。
AI.motivation: 非灰Callaway声子玻尔兹曼方程的求解需要区分法向散射与阻性散射的双弛豫时间近似，并解析模式依赖的频谱。传统迭代方案（CIS）虽避免了整体相空间反演，但其碰撞源迭代在大特征长度下收敛极慢。现有合成加速方案要么只处理非灰单弛豫模型，要么只处理灰体双弛豫模型，缺乏针对模式分辨双弛豫输运的专用加速框架。
AI.method: 开发面向稳态线性化非灰Callaway方程的通用合成迭代方案（GSIS）。通过精确的能量和准动量平衡律，结合一阶Chapman-Enskog本构关系以及从动力学解评估的非平衡项，为法向过程的伪温度和声子漂移速度提供合成近似；阻性过程的伪温度由两者推导得出。每次迭代将迎风节点间断伽辽金动力学扫描与合成方程的杂交间断伽辽金求解耦合，实现高阶空间离散。
AI.result: 通过分支和频率分辨的傅里叶分析，识别了CIS的性能退化，并表明GSIS在考虑的类石墨烯材料中收缩因子始终远离1。渐近分析表明，GSIS在流体动力学极限下退化为Guyer-Krumhansl-like方程的一致离散化，在扩散极限下退化为傅里叶热传导定律。
AI.conclusion: GSIS为模式分辨的双弛豫非灰输运问题提供了专有的高效加速框架，在大特征长度下保持快速收敛，且在不同物理极限下具有一致的渐近行为，为声子玻尔兹曼方程的确定性求解提供了可靠的加速方案。

title: Emergent aggregation from collective foraging
summary: Collective behaviour in living systems is usually modelled as the outcome of a \emph{direct} social drive: agents are rewarded, or hard-wired, to align with or approach their neighbours. Here we show that aggregation can instead emerge from an \emph{indirect} objective. We let reinforcement learning foragers, initially performing a random walk, optimize their dynamics from a purely individual reward for finding replenishable targets, while perceiving only their conspecifics and never the targets themselves. As the visual range grows, the agents undergo a sharp crossover from an environment-tuned individual search to a scale-agnostic collective one, and this crossover coincides with the onset of spatial aggregation. Thus a collective phase arises as a by-product of optimal foraging, without any direct reward for grouping. A minimal analytical first-passage model reproduces the transition as a crossover between the two search strategies. Our results identify indirect, resource-driven reward as a generic route to emergent collective phenomena.

AI.tldr: 本文通过强化学习智能体的模拟，证明群体聚集行为可以不依赖直接的群体奖励，而是作为个体最优觅食（寻找可更新目标）的副产品自发涌现。当视觉范围增大时，个体从环境适应的个体搜索跨界到与尺度无关的集体搜索，同时伴随空间聚集的出现。
AI.motivation: 传统集体行为模型通常假设个体存在直接的社交驱动力（如对齐或靠近邻居的奖励）。作者质疑这一假设，探索能否仅通过纯个体目标（觅食奖励）间接催生集体聚集现象，揭示资源驱动的间接奖励是涌现集体行为的普适路径。
AI.method: 使用强化学习智能体，它们最初执行随机游走，仅以获得可更新目标作为个体奖励来优化动力学。智能体只能感知同类（视觉范围可变），永远无法直接看到目标。同时构建一个最小解析的首达时间（first-passage）模型来重现搜索策略之间的跨界转变。
AI.result: 随着视觉范围增大，智能体经历从环境调谐的个体搜索到尺度无关的集体搜索的尖锐跨界转变，且该转变与空间聚集的起始重合。表明集体相作为最优觅食的副产品出现，无需任何直接聚集奖励。
AI.conclusion: 间接的、资源驱动的奖励可作为涌现集体现象的普适途径。个体为自身利益最优地搜寻资源，其群体层面自然呈现出聚集等集体行为，拓展了我们对集体行为起源的理解。

title: Quantum geometric bounds at finite temperature for one-dimensional chiral systems
summary: The geometry and topology of quantum states are intimately related at zero temperature through exact bounds that constrain geometric quantities from below by topological invariants. At finite-temperature, however, the analogous relations remain unclear. Here we establish rigorous geometric lower bounds for one-dimensional (1D) chiral-symmetric systems at finite temperature within the Uhlmann's framework for mixed states. We show that the Bures length is bounded by a continuous geometric phase angle. We further derive a temperature-dependent bound that interpolates between the zero-temperature limit and a trivial high-temperature regime. Our results are verified analytically and numerically using the Su-Schrieffer-Heeger (SSH) model and the spinless Kitaev chain model. Finally, we discuss potential ways to detect the geometry of the density matrix in quantum circuits, with the quantum imaginary time evolution (QITE) method.

AI.tldr: 本文在Uhlmann混合态框架下，为一维手性对称系统建立了有限温度下的严格几何下界，证明Bures长度受连续几何相位角约束，并推导出从零温极限到高温平凡区间的温度依赖边界。通过SSH模型和Kitaev链模型进行了解析和数值验证，并讨论了在量子电路中利用QITE方法探测密度矩阵几何的可能性。
AI.motivation: 零温下量子态的几何与拓扑通过精确边界紧密关联（几何量被拓扑不变量从下方约束），但有限温度下的类似关系尚不明确。作者希望将这一几何-拓扑联系推广到有限温度情形，填补理论空白。
AI.method: 在Uhlmann混合态框架下，对一维手性对称系统建立严格的几何下界。证明Bures长度受连续几何相位角约束，并推导温度依赖的边界条件，该边界可插值零温极限与高温平凡区间。通过SSH模型和自旋less Kitaev链进行解析与数值验证，并提出利用QITE方法在量子电路中探测密度矩阵几何。
AI.result: 成功建立了有限温度下Bures长度与连续几何相位角之间的严格下界关系；得到随温度变化的边界，能够从零温下界平滑过渡到高温平凡极限；SSH模型和Kitaev链的解析与数值结果均验证了理论推导的正确性。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次在Uhlmann框架下为一维手性对称系统建立了有限温度的几何下界，架起了零温与有限温几何-拓扑关系的桥梁，并为混合态几何的量子实验探测（通过QITE）提供了可行路径。

title: Model-free Reconstruction of Molecular Energy Levels by Broadband Kilohertz-accurate Cavity-enhanced Spectroscopy
summary: Assigning the lines of high-resolution molecular spectra to quantum states requires a Hamiltonian model and substantial expert intervention, so the spectra of larger molecules accumulate vast numbers of unassigned lines. Here we show that molecular energy levels can instead be reconstructed directly from the raw, unassigned transition frequencies, using graph theory alone with no model and no prior assignment. Our inverse graph construction exploits recurring frequency differences and four-cycle closures to assemble an energy-level network at kilohertz precision. The dense, broadband spectra this requires are produced by a cavity-enhanced spectrometer (SCALS) that scans continuously across tens of terahertz at kilohertz accuracy, combining broadband coverage, high sensitivity, and high precision in a single automated instrument. Applied to the water absorption spectrum in the range of 1537--1605~nm, 686 Lamb dips of water were obtained without assignments, and the method reconstructs 158 energy levels that are mostly two orders of magnitude more precise than the corresponding literature values. By removing the assignment barrier, this approach opens a route to exploratory precision spectroscopy of polyatomic molecules without a priori knowledge of transition frequencies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种直接从未标记的分子跃迁频率中重建能级结构的图论方法，无需哈密顿模型或预先分配。结合宽带、高分辨率腔增强光谱仪（SCALS），该方法成功在水分子吸收光谱中重建了158个能级，精度比文献值高两个数量级。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率分子光谱的谱线分配传统上依赖哈密顿模型和大量专家干预，导致大分子光谱中积累大量未分配的谱线，成为精密光谱学发展的瓶颈。
AI.method: 利用逆图构建方法，通过识别重复出现的频率差和四环闭合来组装能级网络；配合SCALS腔增强光谱仪，该仪器可在数十太赫兹范围内以千赫兹精度连续扫描，同时具备宽带覆盖、高灵敏度和高精度。
AI.result: 在1537-1605 nm水吸收光谱范围内，获得686个未分配的Lamb dips，成功重建158个能级，精度比文献值高约两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 该方法消除了谱线分配这一障碍，为多原子分子的探索性精密光谱学开辟了新途径，无需预先了解跃迁频率即可进行光谱分析。

title: Editorial: Promoting Green Computing in High Energy Physics and Astrophysics
comment: 5 pages, 1 figure, editorial of Research Topic in Frontiers in Physics https://www.frontiersin.org/research-topics/62951/promoting-green-computing-in-high-energy-physics-and-astrophysics
summary: This research topic aims to explore and promote strategies for green computing in high-energy physics and astrophysics. The primary objectives include assessing current energy consumption patterns, identifying opportunities for resource optimization, and fostering cross-disciplinary collaborations to enhance sustainability. Key questions to be addressed include: What are the current energy demands in these fields? How can existing technologies be leveraged for more efficient resource usage? What synergies can be identified between high-energy and astrophysics projects to promote green computing?

title: LDA-1/2 for Molecular Systems: A Real-Space Finite-Element Benchmark on the GW100 Set
summary: The LDA-1/2 method provides an efficient correction to semilocal density functional theory for improving ionization energies and band gaps, yet its application to molecular systems has remained limited. In this work, we present an all-electron finite-element implementation of LDA-1/2 within the NESSIE electronic-structure framework and apply it to the GW100 molecular benchmark set with systematically controllable numerical accuracy. The self-energy correction is constructed explicitly from neutral and half-ionized calculations for each molecule, avoiding the use of precomputed atomic correction potentials. The real-space finite-element formulation enables systematic convergence with respect to the discretization and provides a controlled assessment of LDA-1/2 performance. For the GW100 set, the present implementation yields a mean absolute error of 0.472 eV and a root-mean-square error of 0.645 eV relative to CCSD(T) reference ionization energies, substantially improving upon conventional LDA and the previously reported LAPW implementation of LDA-1/2, while achieving accuracy comparable to G0W0@PBE. Convergence tests show that third-order finite elements are sufficient to reach or approach chemical accuracy relative to higher-order calculations for the representative systems considered. The resulting corrected Hamiltonian also improves several lower lying valence states relative to LDA, although the improvement becomes less systematic away from the HOMO. This work provides accurate LDA-1/2 benchmark data for molecular systems and establishes a rigorous finite-element foundation for future molecular GW calculations.

AI.tldr: 本文在NESSIE电子结构框架中实现了LDA-1/2方法的全电子有限元版本，并将其应用于GW100分子基准集。该方法通过显式构建中性及半电离态计算的自能修正，避免了预计算原子修正势。在GW100上相对于CCSD(T)参考电离能实现了0.472 eV的平均绝对误差和0.645 eV的均方根误差，显著优于传统LDA及之前的LAPW实现，精度与G0W0@PBE相当。三阶有限元即可达到接近化学精度的收敛水平。
AI.motivation: LDA-1/2方法能高效修正半局域密度泛函理论以改善电离能和带隙，但其在分子体系中的应用仍十分有限，缺乏系统可控的数值精度评估。
AI.method: 在NESSIE电子结构框架中实现全电子有限元版本的LDA-1/2方法，对每个分子显式构建中性态和半电离态计算以构造自能修正，利用实空间有限元公式实现离散化方面的系统收敛，并在GW100分子基准集上评估性能。
AI.result: 在GW100基准集上，该方法相对CCSD(T)参考电离能实现0.472 eV的平均绝对误差和0.645 eV的均方根误差，显著优于传统LDA及之前LAPW实现的LDA-1/2，精度与G0W0@PBE相当。三阶有限元足以达到或接近化学精度。修正后的哈密顿量也改善了多个较低价态，但离HOMO越远改善越不系统。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为分子体系提供了准确的LDA-1/2基准数据，并为未来分子GW计算建立了严格的有限元基础。

title: A Generalized Model for Disordered Random Sequential Adsorption with Charge-Dependent Deposition
summary: We generalize a one-dimensional random sequential adsorption model (RSA) of charged unit segments in which the deposition position follows a beta kernel determined by the charges bounding the available gap and those of the incoming particle. The interaction parameter \(0\leqλ<1\) interpolates between uniform car parking and strongly localized deposition. We derive a four component generating function equation that provides exact recursions for the complete occupation statistics, although only the mean and variance are analyzed in detail here. Exact finite-shell solutions serve as benchmarks for the Gauss--Jacobi quadrature and Monte Carlo simulations. We prove that, although boundary charges affect finite size behavior, the four boundary states have the same asymptotic mean and variance densities, consequently, we prove that the jammed density is self-averaging. Numerical results show that charge selectivity increases the coverage, especially for mixtures dominated by opposite endpoint charges, which also exhibit strongly reduced fluctuations near \(λ=1\). The model provides a tractable connection between uniform RSA, dynamically generated disorder, and interaction-driven deposition.

AI.tldr: 该论文推广了一维随机顺序吸附（RSA）模型，研究了带有电荷的单元段在沉积时受beta核函数控制的吸附行为。通过四分量生成函数方程推导出完整的占据统计量的精确递推关系，并证明尽管边界电荷影响有限尺寸行为，四个边界状态具有相同的渐近均值和方差密度，从而证明堵塞密度是自平均的。数值结果显示电荷选择性提高覆盖率，尤其在相反端点电荷混合时，且λ接近1时波动显著减少。
AI.motivation: 将一维随机顺序吸附模型从均匀停车（uniform car parking）推广到由电荷决定的局域化沉积，试图建立均匀RSA、动态产生的无序和相互作用驱动沉积之间的联系，为理解带电粒子系统的沉积行为提供可解的理论框架。
AI.method: 推导了一个四分量生成函数方程，提供完整占据统计量的精确递推关系；使用Gauss-Jacobi求积和蒙特卡洛模拟进行数值验证；通过精确有限壳解作为基准，分析均值、方差以及堵塞密度的自平均性质。
AI.result: 证明了尽管边界电荷影响有限尺寸行为，四个边界状态具有相同的渐近均值和方差密度，堵塞密度是自平均的；数值结果显示电荷选择性增加覆盖率，特别是相反端点电荷混合时，且在λ接近1时波动显著减少。
AI.conclusion: 该模型提供了一个在均匀RSA、动态产生的无序和相互作用驱动沉积之间可处理的连接桥梁，为带电多组分系统的吸附动力学提供了精确的理论工具和深入见解。

title: Multi-dimensional spectroscopy of mobile excitons in two-dimensional semiconductors
summary: Multi-dimensional coherent spectroscopy (MDCS) goes beyond standard linear-response probes and provides a powerful tool for investigating correlations between quasiparticles such as excitons (bound electron-hole pairs). Here we present a microscopic theory of MDCS that accounts for the delocalized nature of excitons in two-dimensional semiconductors. In contrast to the more phenomenological few-level approaches typically employed for modelling MDCS, our theory features mobile excitons with continuous momentum degrees of freedom. We find that the energy continuum associated with exciton momenta is crucial for producing interaction-induced decoherence, as well as capturing the interference between different exciton-polaron quasiparticles in the case of charge-doped semiconductors. Crucially, our calculated MDCS spectra agree well with recent experiments on doped monolayer MoSe$_2$ [Hao et al., Nature Communications 8, 15552 (2017)], and they suggest that the interactions between exciton polarons depend strongly on phase-space filling effects, where exciton polarons compete for electrons. Our results demonstrate that microscopic approaches allow one to gain new insights from the fine structure of MDCS on two-dimensional semiconductors, and they illustrate the utility of microscopic approaches to modelling MDCS experiments more generally.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了二维半导体中多维相干光谱(MDCS)的微观理论，考虑了激子（束缚电子-空穴对）的离域特性。与通常采用的唯象少能级方法不同，该理论包含具有连续动量自由度的可移动激子。研究发现激子动量的能量连续谱对产生相互作用诱导的退相干至关重要，并且能捕捉电荷掺杂半导体中不同激子-极化子准粒子之间的干涉。计算结果与实验高度吻合，表明激子-极化子间的相互作用强烈依赖于相空间填充效应。
AI.motivation: 传统用于建模MDCS的方法多为唯象的少能级近似，无法准确描述二维半导体中激子的离域本质和连续动量自由度，因此需要发展更微观的理论来理解激子关联和相互作用诱导的退相干机制。
AI.method: 提出一个微观理论框架来描述二维半导体中的MDCS，该理论将激子视为具有连续动量自由度的可移动准粒子，能够自洽地处理激子-激子相互作用、退相干效应以及掺杂体系中激子-极化子的干涉现象。
AI.result: 发现激子动量的能量连续谱对于产生相互作用诱导的退相干至关重要；理论计算的MDCS光谱与掺杂单层MoSe₂的实验结果高度一致；揭示了激子-极化子相互作用强烈依赖相空间填充效应，即激子-极化子之间竞争电子。
AI.conclusion: 微观理论方法能够从MDCS的精细结构中获取新的物理洞察，展示了微观方法在建模MDCS实验中的广泛适用性和价值。

title: Third-order Algebraic Diagrammatic Construction Renormalized by Particle-Particle Ladders
summary: The algebraic diagrammatic construction (ADC) of the electronic self-energy is based on Moller-Plesset perturbation theory. Its vertices contain bare energy denominators that do not capture renormalization of Hartree-Fock excitations through excited-state correlations. As we show here, Epstein-Nesbet (EN) partitioning of the electronic Hamiltonian overcomes this deficiency at zero extra cost by introducing dressed denominators that resum to infinite order the diagonal elements of ladder diagrams described by the pair propagator in the particle-particle $T$-matrix approximation. Third-order ADC with EN-dressed denominators leads to an almost fourfold increase in accuracy compared to standard ADC(3) on a challenging benchmark set for IPs of closed-shell molecules, reaching an accuracy between EOM-CCSD and EOM-CCSDT. For open-shell systems, the gains in accuracy are more modest, but standard ADC is nevertheless outperformed.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在代数图解构造（ADC）框架中使用Epstein-Nesbet（EN）分割替代标准的Møller-Plesset分割，通过在零额外计算成本下引入"着装"的能量分母，实现对Hartree-Fock激发态重整化的捕获，显著提升第三阶ADC（ADC(3)）在电离势计算中的精度。
AI.motivation: 标准ADC基于Møller-Plesset微扰理论，其顶点包含裸能量分母，无法通过激发态关联捕获Hartree-Fock激发的重整化效应，这限制了ADC(3)的计算精度。
AI.method: 采用Epstein-Nesbet（EN）哈密顿量分割替代标准MP分割，引入着装分母，以零额外计算成本将粒子-粒子T矩阵近似中pair propagator描述的梯型图对角元素求和到无穷阶。
AI.result: 在闭壳层分子的电离势挑战性基准集上，EN着装分母的第三阶ADC比标准ADC(3)精度提高近四倍，达到介于EOM-CCSD和EOM-CCSDT之间的精度。对于开壳层体系，精度提升较为温和，但仍优于标准ADC。
AI.conclusion: EN分割是一种零成本且有效的改进方案，能够通过着装分母增强ADC方法的精度，尤其是在闭壳层体系的电离势计算中表现突出，为ADC方法的进一步发展提供了新思路。

title: Real-Time Monitoring of MHD Liquid Metal Flows with Shallow Recurrent Decoders
summary: State estimation in magnetohydrodynamic flows is critical for real-time monitoring of liquid metal blankets in tokamak fusion reactors. Due to the multiphysics nature of these phenomena, high-fidelity simulations are computationally prohibitive for real-time applications. This work investigates a data- driven Reduced Order Model framework: the Shallow Recurrent Decoder (SHRED) coupled with Principal Component Analysis, to map sparse temperature measurements to the full thermo-hydraulic system's state. The major contribution of this work lies in the two-parameter analysis of a fully three-dimensional domain representative of the DEMO breeding blanket configuration. Here, the flow is subjected to an external magnetic field varying in direction and intensity and is hindered by two cylinders acting as a water-cooling system, which impose a temperature boundary condition on their surfaces. This double-parametric magnetic variation induces nonlinear transitions in the flow dynamics, ranging from chaotic behavior at low magnetic field intensities to laminarized regimes at high intensities, characterized by the formation of asymmetric side layers at an inclination angle of 30 degrees. SHRED reconstruction maintains a mean relative error of approximately 5% for the temperature, pressure, and velocity fields. This accuracy is maintained across both weak and strong magnetic fields, ranging from 0.075 T to 0.300 T, and for inclination angles from 5 to 30 degrees, reflecting its dominant toroidal component. These errors are only slightly larger than the lower error bound dictated by low-rank truncation. The results establish SHRED as a reliable state estimator for complex and realistic engineering applications involving completely unseen parametric scenarios and validate it as an accurate real-time state estimation technique suitable for online monitoring and control of real facilities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了将浅层循环解码器（SHRED）与主成分分析（PCA）结合的数据驱动降阶模型框架，用于在托卡马克聚变反应堆液态金属包层中，从稀疏温度测量映射到完整热-水动力系统状态。在DEMO增殖包层全三维域中进行双参数（磁场方向和强度）分析，SHRED在温度、压力和速度场上保持约5%的平均相对误差，覆盖0.075T至0.300T磁场强度和5至30度倾角范围，验证了其在完全未见参数场景下作为可靠实时状态估计器的能力。
AI.motivation: 磁流体动力学流中的状态估计对托卡马克聚变反应堆液态金属包层的实时监测至关重要，但高保真模拟因多物理特性在实时应用中计算代价过高，亟需高效的降阶模型替代方案。
AI.method: 采用数据驱动的降阶模型框架：将浅层循环解码器（SHRED）与主成分分析（PCA）耦合，利用稀疏温度测量重建完整的液态金属热-水动力系统状态。在具有两个冷却水圆柱的全三维DEMO增殖包层域中，对磁场方向和强度进行双参数变化分析。
AI.result: SHRED重建在温度、压力和速度场上的平均相对误差约为5%，在0.075T至0.300T的磁场强度和5至30度的倾角范围内均能保持精度，误差仅略高于低秩截断的下限。研究发现流动从低磁场强度的混沌行为过渡到高磁场强度的层流化状态，并伴有30度倾角的非对称侧层形成。
AI.conclusion: SHRED被证明是复杂现实工程应用中可靠的状态估计器，能够处理完全未见过的参数场景，作为一种精确的实时状态估计技术，适用于真实设施的在线监测和控制。

title: First-Principles DFT Study of Ferroelectric-to-Antiferroelectric Phase Transitions in LiTaO$_3$ under Electric Boundary Conditions
summary: Ferroelectric and antiferroelectric phases of LiTaO$_3$ compete under different electric boundary conditions. First-principles density-functional calculations show that the high-symmetry reference structure supports two relevant unstable $Γ$ modes: a polar $A_{2u}$ mode at $181i$ cm$^{-1}$ that condenses into the ferroelectric (FE) phase, and an antipolar $A_{2g}$ mode at $103i$ cm$^{-1}$ that condenses into the antiferroelectric (AFE) phase. Under short-circuit conditions the FE phase is the global minimum, with a well depth of $\approx 144$ meV. Under open-circuit conditions the FE phase is destabilized by the unscreened depolarization field and the AFE phase becomes the ground state, with a well depth of $\approx 19$ meV. A weakly unstable longitudinal-optic mode at $48.3i$ cm$^{-1}$ yields a well of only $\approx 0.24$ meV and is thermodynamically irrelevant. Mapping the free energy versus electric displacement $D$ locates a second-order FE$\leftrightarrow$AFE transition at $D_c=0.051$ C/m$^2$, lower than the corresponding $0.07$ C/m$^2$ in LiNbO$_3$ and therefore more accessible experimentally.

AI.tldr: 本文通过第一性原理密度泛函计算，研究了钽酸锂（LiTaO₃）在铁电（FE）与反铁电（AFE）相之间的竞争关系。研究发现，在短路条件下FE相为全局最低能量态（势阱深度约144 meV），而在开路条件下，未屏蔽的退极化场使FE相失稳，AFE相成为基态（势阱深度约19 meV）。通过自由能对电位移D的映射，确定了FE↔AFE二阶相变发生在D_c=0.051 C/m²，低于LiNbO₃中的0.07 C/m²，因此实验上更易实现。
AI.motivation: 理解LiTaO₃中铁电与反铁电相在不同电边界条件下的竞争关系，并确定FE↔AFE相变的临界电位移，以探索其作为可调控功能材料的潜力，特别是有望比LiNbO₃更容易在实验上实现相变调控。
AI.method: 采用第一性原理密度泛函（DFT）计算，分析高对称参考结构中两个不稳定的Γ模：极性的A₂u模（181i cm⁻¹）对应FE相，反极性的A₂g模（103i cm⁻¹）对应AFE相。分别在短路和开路两种电边界条件下计算各相的势阱深度，并通过映射自由能对电位移D的关系来确定FE↔AFE相变点。
AI.result: 短路条件下FE相是全局最小（势阱约144 meV）；开路条件下FE相被退极化场失稳，AFE相成为基态（势阱约19 meV）。弱不稳定的纵向光学模（48.3i cm⁻¹）势阱仅0.24 meV，热力学上不重要。FE↔AFE二阶相变点位于D_c=0.051 C/m²，低于LiNbO₃的0.07 C/m²。
AI.conclusion: LiTaO₃的FE和AFE相可通过改变电边界条件（短路/开路）实现可逆切换，且其FE↔AFE相变临界电位移较LiNbO₃更低，意味着在实验上更容易通过外电场或边界条件调控实现相变，为基于LiTaO₃的可切换铁电/反铁电功能器件提供了理论依据。

title: Solvable relaxation in discrete unitary systems: Ruelle-Pollicott resonances and CMV matrices
summary: Leading eigenvalues of the truncated propagator, known as Ruelle-Pollicott (RP) resonances, are an elegant way of addressing the dynamics of unitary many-body systems. We study unitary propagators in their canonical form, known in the mathematical literature as the CMV matrices, and obtain a number of exact results for RP resonances and the associated norm-diverging eigenvectors. For the simplest CMV class describing a unilateral shift with an impurity, motivated by operator dynamics in dual-unitary circuits, we obtain closed-form results and in particular show that the three independent ways of obtaining RP resonances -- the truncated propagator, analytic continuation of the resolvent, and the rigged Hilbert space approach -- all give the same results. In more realistic CMV matrices, in which shift-like operator dynamics characteristic of chaotic systems is only asymptotic, we rely on the rich theory of orthogonal polynomials on the unit circle and identify two phases. In the first phase, relaxation occurs due to local operators effectively evolving into increasingly nonlocal ones with negligible backflow. Especially interesting is the second phase, which, surprisingly, exhibits faster relaxation because of contributions from the backflow of large operators. Additionally, in the second phase, RP resonances are not equal to the eigenvalues of the truncated propagator, instead, they are ``hidden'' within a ring of ill-conditioned eigenvalues.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了幺正多体系统中Ruelle-Pollicott（RP）共振态的精确性质，利用CMV矩阵（截断传播子的正则形式）获得了闭式结果，并发现两种不同的弛豫相：一阶段因局部算子演化为非局部算子而弛豫，二阶段因大算子回流而加速弛豫且RP共振"隐藏"于病态本征值环中。
AI.motivation: RP共振态是理解幺正多体系统动力学的优雅工具，但对于截断传播子本征值与其对应共振态之间的关系，以及相关的范数发散本征向量，尚缺乏精确的理论结果。作者希望通过CMV矩阵这一数学框架来填补这一空白。
AI.method: 利用CMV矩阵（幺正截断传播子的正则形式）研究RP共振态，结合单位圆上的正交多项式理论。对于最简单的情形（单侧移位加杂质），通过三种独立途径（截断传播子、预解式解析延拓、rigged Hilbert空间方法）获得闭式解并验证一致性；对于更实际的CMV矩阵，利用正交多项式理论识别两个不同的相。
AI.result: 在简单CMV类中，三种获得RP共振态的方法给出相同结果。在更现实的CMV矩阵中识别出两个相：第一相中弛豫源于局部算子演化为日益非局部算子且回流可忽略；第二相中由于大算子回流的贡献而表现出更快的弛豫，且此相中RP共振态不等于截断传播子的本征值，而是"隐藏"在病态本征值环中。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为幺正多体系统中的RP共振态提供了精确的数学基础，揭示了复杂的弛豫动力学，特别是发现了一种反直觉的相，其中回流加速了弛豫，并阐明了RP共振态与截断传播子本征值之间的关系在一般情况下并非平凡对应。

title: Significant modulation of acoustoelectric current associated with charge density wave transitions
summary: We studied acoustoelectric (AE) currents in materials that undergo charge density wave (CDW) transitions, induced by a surface acoustic wave (SAW) on a piezoelectric substrate. The polarity and magnitude of the AE current in NbSe$_3$ and 2H-TaSe$_2$ were modulated due to their CDW transitions. We also found that the sign of the AE current depends on the SAW propagation direction with respect to the crystalline axis of the substrate.A phenomenological model assuming strain-modified conductivity can qualitatively account for the significant modulation of the AE current associated with the CDW transition, as well as the SAW propagation orientation dependence. The present results offer a powerful probe for exploring SAW-electron interactions in van der Waals materials, thereby highlighting their potential for advancing the emerging field of straintronics.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了压电基底上表面声波（SAW）在经历电荷密度波（CDW）转变的材料中诱导的声电（AE）电流。研究发现NbSe₃和2H-TaSe₂中AE电流的极性和大小因CDW转变而受到调制，且AE电流符号取决于SAW传播方向与基底晶轴的关系。基于应变调控电导率的唯象模型能定性解释CDW转变相关的AE电流调制现象及SAW传播方向依赖性。
AI.motivation: 探索表面声波与范德华材料中电子之间的相互作用，特别是在电荷密度波转变条件下AE电流的行为，以推动应变异构学（straintronics）这一新兴领域的发展。
AI.method: 在压电基底上激发表面声波，诱导CDW材料（NbSe₃和2H-TaSe₂）产生声电电流；通过改变SAW传播方向与基底晶轴的关系，测量AE电流的极性和大小；采用应变调控电导率的唯象模型进行定性解释。
AI.result: 观察到CDW转变对AE电流极性和幅值产生显著调制；AE电流符号取决于SAW传播方向与基片晶轴的相对取向；唯象模型可定性重现AE电流的调制现象及方向依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提供了一种强有力的探针来研究范德华材料中的SAW-电子相互作用，展示了其在应变异构学领域的应用潜力。

title: Charge transfer and competing symmetry breaking drive orbital reconstruction and emergent ferromagnetism in insulating oxide superlattices
summary: Electron correlation, hopping, and ligand-to-metal charge transfer collectively lead to diverse electronic and magnetic phenomena in 3$d$ transition-metal oxides, where directional d orbitals make hopping highly sensitive to symmetry-dependent orbital overlap. Heterostructure engineering with atomically flat interfaces adds symmetry-breaking charge transfer as a further route to emergent behavior, yet whether interfacial mismatch between constituent oxides of a superlattice shapes ground states independent of epitaxial strain remains unresolved. Here we examine superlattices combining NdNiO$_3$ with Mott-insulating NdMnO$_3$. Varying layer thickness and combining transport with X-ray spectroscopy, we show that electron transfer from NdMnO$_3$ to NdNiO$_3$ drives a room-temperature insulating state with a distinct electronic structure, accompanied by a reversal in orbital symmetry beyond simple strain considerations, underscoring the interface's central role.
